ātmanyeva na mātyantarindāviva rasāyanam || ṃo_2,13.7 ||
"ātmanyeva na māti" na prabhavati | atyantānandamayatvāditi bhāvaḥ | "mananārambha"rahitasya "kautukarahitasya" ca ānandena sv"ātmani" amānaṃ na yuktamiti lokaprasiddhir"api"śabdābhiprāyaḥ | rasāyanamamṛtam || ṃoṭ_2,13.7 ||


na karotīndrajālāni nānudhāvati vāsanām |
bālacāpalamutsṛjya pūrṇameva virājate || ṃo_2,13.8 ||
"indrajālāni" mantrādiprabhāvena siddhāni ākāśagamanādīni | "vāsanāṃ nānudhāvati" api tu tato nivṛttimeva karoti | bālavatcāpalam "bālacāpalamutsṛjya" | "pūrṇam" tṛptisahitaṃ yathā bhavati | tathā "virājate" || ṃoṭ_2,13.8 ||


ātmatattvāvalokanasyaiva pūrvoktāsu vṛttiṣu kāraṇatvaṃ gadyena kathayati
evaṃvidhā hi vṛttaya ātmatattvāvalokanāllabhyante | nānyatas| tasmādvicāreṇātmaivānveṣṭavya upāsanīyo jñātavyo yāvajjīvaṃ puruṣena netaraditi || ṃoṭ_2,13.9 ||
"itī"tyantam | ṭīkā | "hi" yasmāt | "evaṃvidhāḥ" pūrvoktāḥ | vṛttayaḥ vyāpārāḥ | "ātmatattvasya" paramātmasvarūpasya | yad"avalokanaṃ" | tasmādeva | "puruṣeṇa labhyante" | "nānyataḥ" | "tasmādpuruṣeṇa yāvajjīvaṃ vicāreṇātmaivānveṣṭavyaḥ" | kiṃrūpo'sāviti vimarśanīyaḥ | tataḥ "upāsanīyaḥ" | upāsanaṃ cātra avicchinnapravāheṇānusandhānaviṣayīkaraṇameva jñeyam | tataḥ "jñātavyaḥ" | sthūladehādivyatirekena sthūladehavatniḥsaṃśayamātmatattvena jñātavyaḥ | "itarat" sthūladehādi | "na" jñātavyam | "iti"śabdaḥ gadyasamāptau || ṃoṭ_2,13.9 ||


nanvātmāvalokanaṃ kartavyatvena tvayā pratipāditam | tadavalokanaṃ kathaṃ setsyatīty | atra padyenāha
svānubhūteḥ suśāstrasya guroścaivaikavākyatā |
yatrābhyāsena tenātmā santatenāvalokyate || ṃo_2,13.10 ||
"svā" nijā | yā "anubhūtiḥ" | tasyāḥ | "suśāstrasya" śobhanaśāstrasya | "guroḥ" sadguroś | "ca" iti trayasya | "yatra" yasminabhyāse | "ekavākyatā" arthātmelanaṃ syāt | "santatenā"vicchinnena | "tenābhyāsena" karaṇena | puruṣeṇa kartrā | "ātmāvalokyate" || ṃoṭ_2,13.10 ||


avahelitaśāstrārthairavajñātamahājanaiḥ  |
kaṣṭāmapyāpadaṃ prāpto na mūḍhaiḥ samatāmiyāt || ṃo_2,13.11 ||
svasthastu katham "iyād" ity"api"śabdābhiprāyaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.11 ||



etatprasaṅgena maurkhyaṃ nindati
na vyādhirna viṣaṃ nāpattathā nāmāsti bhūtale |
khedāya svaśarīrasthaṃ maurkhyameva yathā nṛṇām || ṃo_2,13.12 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.12 ||


kiṃcitsaṃskṛtabuddhīnāṃ śravyaṃ śāstramidaṃ yathā |
maurkhyāpahaṃ tathā śāstramanyadasti na kiṃcana || ṃo_2,13.13 ||
"kiṃcitsaṃskṛtabuddhīnām" padapadārthajñānāmityarthaḥ | "śravyam" śravaṇārham | "idaṃ" mokṣopāyākhyam | "maurkhyāpahaṃ" maurkhyamupahantīti "maurkhyāpaham" || ṃoṭ_2,13.13 ||


idaṃ śravyaṃ sukhakaraṃ kathādṛṣṭāntasundaram |
aviruddhamaśeṣeṇa śāstravākyārthabandhunā || ṃo_2,13.14 ||
kathābhiḥ vakṣyamāṇāḥ dṛṣṭāntāḥ "kathādṛṣṭāntāḥ" | taiḥ "sundaram" | "śāstravākyānāṃ" yaḥ "arthaḥ" | sa eva "bandhuḥ" | tena "aviruddham" | śāstrārthānusārītyarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.14 ||


āpado yā duruttārā yāśca tucchāḥ kuyonayaḥ |
tāstā maurkhyātprasūyante khadirātkaṇṭhakā iva || ṃo_2,13.15 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.15 ||


varaṃ śarāvahastasya caṇḍālāgāravīthiṣu |
bhikṣārthamaṭanaṃ rāma na maurkhyahatajīvitam || ṃo_2,13.16 ||
"aṭanaṃ" bhramaṇam || ṃoṭ_2,13.16 ||


imamālokamāsādya mokṣopāyamayaṃ janaḥ |
andhatāmeti na punaḥ kaścinmohatamasyapi || ṃo_2,13.17 ||
"ālokam" paratattvaprakāśakatvātālokasvarūpam || ṃoṭ_2,13.17 ||


tāvannayati saṃkocaṃ tṛṣṇā śyāmā narāmbujam |
yāvadvivekasūryasya noditā vimalā prabhā || ṃo_2,13.18 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.18 ||


saṃsāraduḥkhamokṣārthaṃ mādṛśaiḥ saha bandhubhiḥ |
svarūpamātmano jñātvā guruśāstrapramāṇataḥ || ṃo_2,13.19 ||
"mādṛśaiḥ" sādhubhirityarthaḥ | guruśāstrākhyaṃ yat"pramāṇaṃ" pramākaraṇam | tasmāt"guruśāstrapramāṇataḥ" | "jñātve"tyasyānantaraṃ stheyamiti śeṣaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.19 ||



jīvanmuktāścarantīha yathā hariharādayaḥ |
yathā brahmarṣayaścānye tathā vihara rāghava || ṃo_2,13.20 ||
"vihara" harṣāmarṣarahitatvena krīḍāṃ kuru || ṃoṭ_2,13.20 ||


anantānīha duḥkhāni sukhaṃ kṣaṇalavopamam |
nātaḥ sukheṣu badhnīyāddṛṣṭiṃ duḥkhānubandhiṣu || ṃo_2,13.21 ||
"duḥkhānubandhiṣu" duḥkhānuviddheṣu || ṃoṭ_2,13.21 ||


punaḥ kiṃ kāryamity | atrāha
yadanantamanāyāsaṃ tatpadaṃ sārasiddhaye |
sādhanīyaṃ prayatnena puruṣeṇa vijānatā || ṃo_2,13.22 ||
"anantam" trividhaparicchedarahitam | "anāyāsaṃ" āyāsasādhyatvābhāvāt | "sārasiddhaye" paramapuruṣārthasiddhaye | "sādhanīyaṃ" svopalabdhiviṣayatāṃ neyam | "vijānatā" kiṃcinmātrajñānayuktena mūrkhasyātrānadhikaratvāt || ṃoṭ_2,13.22 ||


ta eva puruṣārthasya bhājanaṃ puruṣottamāḥ |
anuttamapadālambi mano yeṣāṃ gatajvaram || ṃo_2,13.23 ||
avidyamāna uttamaḥ yasmāttat"anuttamam" niratiśayamiti yāvat | tādṛśaṃ yat"padam" | tat"ālambate" iti tādṛśam || ṃoṭ_2,13.23 ||


saṃbhogāśanamātreṣu rājyādiṣu sukheṣu ye |
saṃtuṣṭā duṣṭamanaso viddhi tānandhadundubhān || ṃo_2,13.24 ||
"andhadundubhān" andharājilān | asamyagdarśitvādityarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.24 ||



ye śaṭheṣu duranteṣu duṣkṛtārambhaśāliṣu |
dviṣatsu mitrarūpeṣu bhaktā vai bhogabhogiṣu || ṃo_2,13.25 ||
te yānti durgamāddurgaṃ duḥkhādduḥkhaṃ bhayādbhayam |
narakānnarakaṃ mūḍhā mohamantharabuddhayaḥ || ṃo_2,13.26 ||
"mitrarūpeṣu dviṣatsu" ā mukhe sukhakāritvāt"mohamantharā" mohanirbharā | "buddhiḥ" yeṣāṃ te | tādṛśāḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.2526 ||


parasparavināśotke śreyasyau na kadācana |
sukhaduḥkhadaśe rāma taḍitprasarabhaṅgure || ṃo_2,13.27 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.27 ||


ye viraktā mahātmānaḥ suviviktā bhavādṛśaḥ |
puruṣān viddhi tān vandyān bhogamokṣaikabhāginaḥ || ṃo_2,13.28 ||
"bhogabhāktvaṃ" caiṣāṃ pravāhagatameva jñeyam | na yatnasādhitam || ṃoṭ_2,13.28 ||


vivekaṃ paramāśritya vairāgyābhyāsayogataḥ  |
saṃsārasaritaṃ ghorāmimāmāpadamuttaret || ṃo_2,13.29 ||
"abhyāsaḥ" sacchāstrābhyāsaḥ | "āpadam" āpadrūpām || ṃoṭ_2,13.29 ||



na suptavyaṃ tu saṃsāramāyāsviha hi jānatā |
viṣamūrcchanasaṃmohadāyinīṣu vivekinā || ṃo_2,13.30 ||
"na suptavyam" avahelā na kartavyā || ṃoṭ_2,13.30 ||


saṃsāramimamāsādya yastiṣṭhatyavahelayā |
jvalitasya gṛhasyoccaiḥ śete tārṇasya so'ntare || ṃo_2,13.31 ||
"tārṇasya" tṛṇanirmitasya || ṃoṭ_2,13.31 ||


yatprāpya na nivartante yadāsādya na śocyate |
tatpadaṃ śemuṣīlabhyamastyevātra na saṃśayaḥ || ṃo_2,13.32 ||
"śemuṣīlabhyameva" buddhilabhyameva | na tu bāhyayatnalabhyam || ṃoṭ_2,13.32 ||


nanu yadi tatpadaṃ nāsti tatkiṃ śemuṣyā labhyate ity | atrāha
nāsti cettadvicāreṇa doṣaḥ ko bhavatāṃ bhavet |
asti cettatsamuttīrṇā bhaviṣyatha bhavārṇavāt || ṃo_2,13.33 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.33 ||


pravṛttiḥ puruṣasyeha mokṣopāyavicāraṇe |
yadā bhavatyāśu tadā mokṣabhāgī sa ucyate || ṃo_2,13.34 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.34 ||


anapāyi nirāśaṅkaṃ svāsthyaṃ vigatavibhramam |
na vinā kevalībhāvaṃ vidyate bhuvanatraye || ṃo_2,13.35 ||
"svāsthyam" svasthatā | "kevalībhāvaṃ vinā" advitīyatāṃ vinā || ṃoṭ_2,13.35 ||


tatprāptāvuttamaprāptau na kleśa upayujyate |
na mitrāṇyupakurvanti na dhanāni na bāndhavāḥ || ṃo_2,13.36 ||
"tatprāptau" kevalībhāvaprāptau | "kleśaḥ" śārīrikaḥ kleśaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.36 ||


na hastapādacalanaṃ na deśāntarasaṃgamaḥ |
kleśātiśayasādhyo vā na tīrthāyatanāśrayaḥ || ṃo_2,13.37 ||
asminnarthe "hastapādā"di"calanaṃ na" bhavati | "deśāntarasaṃgamaḥ" ca "na" bhavati | ayamarthaḥ "kleśātiśayasādhyaḥ na" bhavati | "tīrthāyatanāśrayaḥ" ca "na" bhavati || ṃoṭ_2,13.37 ||



puruṣārthaikasādhyena vāsanaikārthakarmaṇā |
kevalaṃ tanmanomātrajayenāsādyate padam || ṃo_2,13.38 ||
puruṣeṇa "tat" kevalībhāvākhyaṃ "padam" | "evalaṃ manomātrajayena āsādyate" prāpyate | "manomātrajayena" kathaṃbhūtena | "puruṣārthena" pauruṣeṇa | "ekam" kevalaṃ "sādhyena" | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtena "vāsanaikārthakarmaṇā" | "vāsanā" bhāvanā | sā eva "ekārthaḥ" | tasya "karmaṇā" | bhāvanāmātrasādhyenetyarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.38 ||


vivekamātrasādhyaṃ tadvicāraikāntaniścayam |
tyajatā duḥkhajālāni nareṇa tadavāpyate || ṃo_2,13.39 ||
"tadvicāreṇa" tadviṣayeṇa vivekena | "ekaṃ" kevalam | "niścayaḥ" yasya | tam | vicāraniśceyamityarthaḥ | "tat" kevalībhāvākhyaṃ padam || ṃoṭ_2,13.39 ||


sukhasevyāsanasthena tadvicāravatā svayam |
na śocyate padaṃ prāpya na ca bhūyo'bhijāyate || ṃo_2,13.40 ||
"tadvicāravatā" kevalībhāvavicārayuktena | tat"padaṃ" kevalībhāvākhyaṃ padam || ṃoṭ_2,13.40 ||


tatsamastasukhāsārasīmāntaṃ sādhavo viduḥ |
tadanuttamaniṣṣyandaṃ paramāhū rasāyanam || ṃo_2,13.41 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.41 ||


kṣayitvātsarvabhāvānāṃ svargamānuṣyayordvayoḥ |
sukhaṃ nāstyeva salilaṃ mṛgatṛṣṇāsvivaitayoḥ || ṃo_2,13.42 ||
"svargamānuṣyayoḥ" svarlokamanuṣyalokayoḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.42 ||


ato manojayaścintyaḥ śamasaṃtoṣasādhanaḥ |
anantaśamasaṃbhogastasmādānanda āpyate || ṃo_2,13.43 ||
"ataḥ" kāraṇāt | puruṣeṇa "manojayaḥ cintyaḥ" | kathaṃbhūtaḥ | "śamasaṃtoṣau sādhanaṃ" yasya | tādṛśaḥ puruṣaḥ | "tasmāt" manojayāt | "anantaśamasya saṃbhogaḥ" camatkāraḥ | śamāsvādarūpaḥ iti yāvat | "ānandaḥ āpyate" prāpyate || ṃoṭ_2,13.43 ||
jīvatā gacchatā caiva bhramatā patatā tathā |
rakṣasā dānavenāpi devena puruṣeṇa vā || ṃo_2,13.44 ||
manaḥpraśamanodbhūtaṃ tatprāpya paramaṃ sukham |
vikāsiśamapuṣpasya vivekoccataroḥ phalam || ṃo_2,13.45 ||
vyavahārapareṇāpi kāryavṛndamacinvatā |
bhānunevāmbarasthena nojjhyate na ca vāñchyate || ṃo_2,13.46 ||
"jīvatā gacchatā bhramatā" | atha "patatā" | upalakṣaṇaṃ caitat | sarvāḥ kriyāḥ kurvateti yāvat | "rakṣasā dānavenāpi devena puruṣeṇa vā manaḥpraśamanodbhūtaṃ" tathā "vikāsiśamapuṣpasya" "vivekoccataroḥ" phalam | tatparamaṃ sukhaṃ nirvāṇākhyaṃ sukham | "prāpyāmbarasthena bhānunā iva nojjhyate na ca vāñchyate" sūryavatupekṣāmeva sarvatra kriyate ityarthaḥ | rakṣaḥprabhṛtinā kathaṃbhūtena | "vyavahārapareṇāpi kāryavṛndam" kāryasamūham | "acinvatā" nāhaṃkarteti niścayātsvakṛtatvenānanubhavatā || ṃoṭ_2,13.4446 ||



manaḥ praśāntamatyacchaṃ viśrāntaṃ gatavibhramam |
anīhaṃ vigatābhīṣṭaṃ nābhivāñchati nojjhati || ṃo_2,13.47 ||
"anīham" vikalpākhyaceṣṭārahitam | "vigatābhīṣṭam" abhīṣṭamidamiti niścayarahitam | pravāhāgatamupekṣayā eva karotīti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.47 ||


pūrvataraṃ prakṛtānāṃ śamādidvārapālānāṃ nirṇayaṃ prastauti
mokṣadvāre dvārapālānimāñśṛṇu yathākramam |
yeṣāmekatamāsaktyā mokṣadvāre praviśyate || ṃo_2,13.48 ||
"ekatamāsaktyā" ekatamāsevanena || ṃoṭ_2,13.48 ||



tatrāpi prathamoddiṣṭaṃ śamaṃ nirūpayati
duḥkhadoṣadaśā dīrghā saṃsāramarumaṇḍalī |
jantoḥ śītalatāmeti śītalena śamāmbunā || ṃo_2,13.49 ||
duḥkhadoṣarūpā daśā yasyāṃ sā "duḥkhadoṣadaśā" || ṃoṭ_2,13.49 ||


śamenāsādyate śreyaḥ śamo hi paramaṃ padam |
śamaḥ śivaṃ śamaḥ śāntiḥ śamo bhrāntinivāraṇam || ṃo_2,13.50 ||
"paramaṃ padam" cinmātrākhyamutkṛṣṭaṃ sthānam || ṃoṭ_2,13.50 ||


puṃsaḥ praśamatṛptasya śītalācchatarātmanaḥ |
śamatoṣitacittasya śatrurapyeti mitratām || ṃo_2,13.51 ||
dveṣeṇaiva hi śatruḥ śatruḥ bhavati | sa ca tasya nāstīti tasya "śatruḥ mitratāmetī"ti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.51 ||


śamacandramasā yeṣāmāśayaḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ |
kṣīrābdhīnāmivodeti teṣāṃ paramaśuddhatā || ṃo_2,13.52 ||
"paramaśuddhatā" vāsanākhyamalarāhityam || ṃoṭ_2,13.52 ||



hṛtkuśeśayakośeṣu yeṣāṃ śamakuśeśayam  |
satāṃ vikasitaṃ te hi dvihṛtpadmāḥ samā hareḥ || ṃo_2,13.53 ||
"harerdvihṛtpadmatvaṃ" nābhisthasya padmasya sthitatvājjñeyam || ṃoṭ_2,13.53 ||



śamaśrīḥ śobhate yeṣāṃ mukhendāvakalaṅkite |
te'mī kulendavo vandyāḥ saundaryavijitendavaḥ || ṃo_2,13.54 ||
"akalaṅkitatvam" evātra indujaye hetuḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.54 ||


trailokyodaravartinyo nānandāya tathā śriyaḥ |
sāmrājyasaṃpatpratimā yathā śamavibhūtayaḥ || ṃo_2,13.55 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.55 ||


yāni duḥkhāni yāstṛṣṇā duḥsahā ye durādhayaḥ |
tatsarvaṃ śāntacetassu tamo'rkeṣviva naśyati || ṃo_2,13.56 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.56 ||


mano hi sarvabhūtānāṃ prasādamanugacchati |
na tathendau yathā śānte jane janitakautukam || ṃo_2,13.57 ||
"prasādam" prasannatām || ṃoṭ_2,13.57 ||


śamaśālini sauhārdavati sarveṣu jantuṣu |
sujane paramaṃ tattvaṃ svayameva prasīdati || ṃo_2,13.58 ||
"paramaṃ tattvam" paramātmatattvam | "svayamevā"yatnameva | "prasīdati" svarūpadarśanākhyaṃ prasādaṃ karotītyarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.58 ||



mātarīva paraṃ yānti viṣamāṇi mṛdūni ca |
viśvāsamiha bhūtāni sarvāṇi śamaśālini || ṃo_2,13.59 ||
"viṣamāṇi" hiṃsāni | "mṛdūni" komalāni || ṃoṭ_2,13.59 ||



na rasāyanapānena na lakṣmyāliṅganena ca |
tathā sukhamavāpnoti śamenāntaryathā janaḥ || ṃo_2,13.60 ||
"antaḥ" manasi || ṃoṭ_2,13.60 ||


sarvādhivyādhivalitaṃ krāntaṃ tṛṣṇāvaratrayā |
manaḥ śamāmṛtāsekaiḥ samāśvāsaya rāghava || ṃo_2,13.61 ||
"samāśvāsaya" śītalaya || ṃoṭ_2,13.61 ||



yatkaroṣi yadaśnāsi śamaśītalayā dhiyā |
tatte'tisvadate svādu netarattāntamānasam || ṃo_2,13.62 ||
"svadate" rocate | camatkāraṃ karotīti yāvat | "tāntam" mlāniyuktaṃ kṛtam | "mānasaṃ" yena tat || ṃoṭ_2,13.62 ||



śamāmṛtarasāsnātaṃ mano yāmeti nirvṛtim |
chinnānyapi tayāṅgāni manye rohanti rāghava || ṃo_2,13.63 ||
"śamāmṛtarasāsnātaṃ manaḥ yāṃ nirvṛtimeti" | he "rāghavā"haṃ "manye" | "tayā" nirvṛtyā | "chinnānyapi aṅgāni rohanti" || ṃoṭ_2,13.63 ||



na piśācā na rakṣāṃsi na daityā na ca śatravaḥ |
na ca vyāghrabhujaṅgādyā dviṣanti śamaśālinam || ṃo_2,13.64 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.64 ||


susaṃnaddhasamastāṅgaṃ praśamāmṛtavarmaṇā |
vedhayanti na duḥkhāni śarā vajraśilāmiva || ṃo_2,13.65 ||
"vedhayanti" tāḍayanti || ṃoṭ_2,13.65 ||


na tathā rājate rājā mānyāntaḥpurasaṃsthitaḥ |
samayā svasthayā vṛttyā yathopaśamaśobhitaḥ || ṃo_2,13.66 ||
"vṛttyā" vyāpāreṇa || ṃoṭ_2,13.66 ||



prāṇātpriyataraṃ dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭimeti na tāṃ janaḥ |
yāmāyāti janaṃ śāntamavalokya samāśayam || ṃo_2,13.67 ||
"samāśayam" samacetasam || ṃoṭ_2,13.67 ||



samayā śamaśālinyā vṛttyā yaḥ sādhu vartate |
abhinanditayā loke jīvatīha sa netaraḥ || ṃo_2,13.68 ||
"vartate" tiṣṭhati | "itaraḥ" aśāntaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.68 ||


anuddhatamanāḥ śāntaḥ sādhu karma karoti yat |
tatsarvamabhinandanti tasyemā bhūtajātayaḥ || ṃo_2,13.69 ||
"abhinandanti" stuvanti || ṃoṭ_2,13.69 ||


śāntasvarūpanirṇayadvāreṇa śamasvarūpaṃ niścinoti
śrutvā spṛṣṭvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca bhuktvā ghrātvā śubhāśubham |
na hṛṣyati glāyati yaḥ sa śānta iti kathyate || ṃo_2,13.70 ||
upekṣā eva śāntiriti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.70 ||


yaḥ samaḥ sarvabhāveṣu nābhivāñchati nojjhati |
jitvendriyāṇi yatnena sa śānta iti kathyate || ṃo_2,13.71 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.71 ||


tuṣārakarabimbācchaṃ mano yasya nirākulam |
maraṇotsavayuddheṣu sa śānta iti kathyate || ṃo_2,13.72 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.72 ||


sthito'pi na sthita iva na hṛṣyati na kupyati |
yaḥ suṣuptamanāḥ svasthaḥ sa śānta iti kathyate || ṃo_2,13.73 ||
"suṣuptamanāḥ" harṣāmarṣānusandhānarahitaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.73 ||



amṛtasyandasubhagā yasya sarvajanaṃ prati |
dṛṣṭiḥ prasarati prītā sa śānta iti kathyate || ṃo_2,13.74 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.74 ||


spaṣṭāvadātayā buddhyā yathaivāntastathā bahiḥ |
dṛśyante yasya kāryāṇi sa śānta iti kathyate || ṃo_2,13.75 ||
kapaṭarāhityāditi bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,13.75 ||


apyāpatsu durantāsu kalpānteṣu dahatsvapi |
tucchehaṃ na mano yasya sa śānta iti kathyate || ṃo_2,13.76 ||
"tuccheham" tucchopāyaparam || ṃoṭ_2,13.76 ||


yo'ntaḥ śītalatāṃ yāto yo bhāveṣu na majjati |
vyavahārī na saṃmūḍhaḥ sa śānta iti kathyate || ṃo_2,13.77 ||
"na majjati" rāgodrekeṇāsakto na bhavati | "vyavahārī" vyavahārakārī | "na saṃmūḍhaḥ" na vyavahārarahitaḥ | vyavahārarahitasya hi amajjanaṃ vyavahārābhāvakṛtameva na śāntikṛtam || ṃoṭ_2,13.77 ||



ākāśasadṛśī yasya nityaṃ svavyavahāriṇaḥ |
kalaṅkameti na matiḥ sa śānta iti kathyate || ṃo_2,13.78 ||
"svaḥ" nijaḥ | "vyavahāraḥ" asyāstīti tādṛśasya || ṃoṭ_2,13.78 ||


tapasviṣu bahujñeṣu yājakeṣu nṛpeṣu ca |
balavatsu guṇāḍhyeṣu śamavāneva rājate || ṃo_2,13.79 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.79 ||


śamasaṃsaktamanasāṃ mahatāṃ guṇaśālinām |
udeti nirvṛtiścittājjyotsneva himarociṣaḥ || ṃo_2,13.80 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.80 ||


sīmānto guṇapūgānāṃ pauruṣaikāntabhūṣaṇam |
saṃkaṭeṣvabhayasthānaṃ śamaḥ śrīmān virājate || ṃo_2,13.81 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,13.81 ||


sargāntaślokena śamanirūpaṇaṃ samāpayati
śamamamṛtamahāryamāryajuṣṭaṃ
paramavalambya padaṃ paraṃ prayātāḥ |
raghutanaya yathā mahānubhāvāḥ
kramamanupālaya siddhaye tameva || ṃo_2,13.82 ||
he "raghutanaya" | "mahānubhāvāḥ" puruṣāḥ | "amṛtam" amṛtarūpam | "ahāryam" anāśyam "āryajuṣṭam" |" śamaṃ" pūrvoktasvarūpaṃ śamaṃ "avalambya" | "paraṃ" padaṃ paracitsvarūpamutkṛṣṭaṃ sthānam | yathā "prayātāḥ" | tvam "tam" tathāvidham | "kramaṃ siddhaye anupālaya" | iti śivam || ṃoṭ_2,13.82 ||


iti śrībhāskarakaṇṭhaviracitāyāṃ śrīmokṣopāyaṭīkāyāṃ mumukṣuprakaraṇe trayodaśaḥ sargaḥ || 2,13 ||


************************************************************************

oṃ vivekanirṇayaṃ prastauti
śāstrāvabodhāmalayā dhiyā paramapūtayā | |
kartavyaḥ kāraṇajñena vicāro'niśamātmanaḥ || ṃo_2,14.1 ||"
kāraṇajñena" kim | kena saṃpadyate iti jānatā puruṣeṇa | "dhiyā ātmanaḥ vicāraḥ aniśaṃ kartavyaḥ" || ṃoṭ_2,14.1 ||


nanu vicāreṇa kiṃ setsyati ity | atrāha
vicārāttīkṣṇatāmetya dhīḥ paśyati paraṃ padam |
dīrghasaṃsārarogasya vicāro hi mahauṣadham || ṃo_2,14.2 ||
"paraṃ padam" śuddhacinmātrākhyaṃ mahāsthānam || ṃoṭ_2,14.2 ||


āpadvanamanantehāparipallavitākṛti  |
vicārakrakacacchinnaṃ naiva bhūyaḥ prarohati || ṃo_2,14.3 ||
"anantāḥ" yāḥ "īhāḥ" ceṣṭāḥ | tābhiḥ "paripallavitā" puṣṭībhūtā | "ākṛtiḥ" yasya tat || ṃoṭ_2,14.3 ||



moheṣu bandhunāśeṣu saṃkaṭeṣu bhrameṣu ca |
sarveṣveva mahāprājña vicāro hi satāṃ gatiḥ || ṃo_2,14.4 ||
"gatiḥ" śaraṇam || ṃoṭ_2,14.4 ||


na vicāraṃ vinā kaścidupāyo'sti vipacchame |
vicārādaśubhaṃ tyaktvā śubhamāyāti dhīḥ satām || ṃo_2,14.5 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,14.5 ||


balaṃ buddhiśca tejaśca pratipattiḥ kriyāphalam |
phalantyetāni sarvāṇi vicāreṇaiva dhīmataḥ || ṃo_2,14.6 ||
"pratipattiḥ" jñānam | avivekena tu kṛtāni "etāni" anarthamevotpādayantīti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.6 ||



yuktāyuktamahādīpamabhivāñchitasādhakam |
sphāraṃ vicāramāśritya saṃsārajaladhiṃ taret || ṃo_2,14.7 ||
"yuktāyuktamahādīpaṃ" idaṃ yuktamidaṃ tvayuktamiti prakāśakamityarthaḥ | "sphāraṃ" vistīrṇam || ṃoṭ_2,14.7 ||


ālūnahṛdayāmbhojaṃ mahāmohamataṅgajam |
vidārayati śuddhātmā vicārodārakesarī || ṃo_2,14.8 ||
"vidārayati" vināśayati || ṃoṭ_2,14.8 ||


mūḍhāḥ kālavaśeneha yadgatāḥ paramaṃ padam |
tadvicārapradīpasya vijṛmbhitamanuttamam || ṃo_2,14.9 ||
"kālena" hi "mūḍhā" api śuddhacinmātrākhyaṃ "paramaṃ padaṃ" prāpnuvanti | "vijṛmbhitam" vilasitam | "anuttamam" niratiśayam || ṃoṭ_2,14.9 ||


rājyāni saṃpadaḥ sphāro bhogo mokṣaśca śāśvataḥ |
vicārakalpavṛkṣasya phalānyetāni rāghava  || ṃo_2,14.10 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,14.10 ||



yā vivekavilāsinyo matayo mahatāmiha |
na tā vipadi majjanti tumbakānīva vāriṇi || ṃo_2,14.11 ||
vivekavilāsaḥ āsāmastīti "vivekavilāsinyaḥ" || ṃoṭ_2,14.11 ||


vicārodayahāriṇyā dhiyā vyavaharanti ye |
phalānāmatyudārāṇāṃ bhājanaṃ hi bhavanti te || ṃo_2,14.12 ||
"vicārodayena hāriṇyā" manoharayā || ṃoṭ_2,14.12 ||


mūrkhahṛtkānanasthānāmāśāprasararodhinām |
avicārakarañjānāṃ mañjaryo duḥkharītayaḥ || ṃo_2,14.13 ||
"āśā" mokṣāśā | tasyāḥ yaḥ "prasaraḥ" | taṃ rundhantīti tādṛśānāṃ dik"prasararodhināṃ" ca | "karañjānāṃ" kaṇṭakavṛkṣāṇām | "duḥkharītayaḥ" duḥkharacanāḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.13 ||



kajjalakṣodamalinā madirāmodadhāriṇī |
avicāramayī nidrā yātu te rāghava kṣayam || ṃo_2,14.14 ||
"kajjalakṣodena" mantrasaṃskṛtena | "kajjalakṣodena malinā" ghanā | kajjalakṣodavat"malinā" cātyantakāluṣyāt | "madirā modaṃ dhārayatī"ti tādṛśī | madirāmodenāpi "nidrā" ghanībhavati | "avicāramayī" avicārasvarūpā tāmeva "kṣayaṃ" nayeti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.14 ||


mahāpadyapi dīrgheṣu sadvicāraparo naraḥ |
na nimajjati moheṣu tejorāśistamassviva || ṃo_2,14.15 ||
"moheṣu" kiṃ karomītyevaṃrūpeṣu || ṃoṭ_2,14.15 ||



mānase sarasi svacche vicārakamalotkaraḥ |
nūnaṃ vikasito yasya himavāniva bhāti saḥ || ṃo_2,14.16 ||
"mānase sarasi" hṛdayākhye sarasi mānasākhye sarasīti ca || ṃoṭ_2,14.16 ||


vicāravikalā yasya matirmāndyamupeyuṣaḥ |
tasyodetyaśaniścandrānmudhā yakṣaḥ śiśoriva || ṃo_2,14.17 ||
"vicāravikalā" vicārarahitā | "māndyaṃ" jāḍyam | "candrāt" citsūryapratibimbarūpatvena candratulyātsaṃsārāt | "aśaniḥ" bhāvābhāvakṛtaharṣāmarṣarūpaṃ vajramāścaryaṃ ca candrādaśanerutpādaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.17 ||



duḥkhaṣaṇḍakavalmīkaṃ vipannavalatāmadhuḥ |
rāma dūre parityājyo nirviveko narādhamaḥ || ṃo_2,14.18 ||
"narādhamaḥ" kim | "duḥkhaḥ ṣaṇḍakānāṃ valmīkam" | valmīke hi kaṇṭakaṣaṇḍakāni bhavanti | punaḥ kaḥ | "vipad" eva "navalatā" | tasyāḥ "madhuḥ" vasantaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.18 ||


ye kecana durārambhā durācārā durādhayaḥ |
avicāreṇa te bhānti vetālāstamasā yathā || ṃo_2,14.19 ||
"durārambhāḥ" kutsitāḥ kāryārambhāḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.19 ||


avicāriṇamekāntajaraddrumasadharmakam |
akṣamaṃ sādhukāryeṣu dūre kuru raghūdvaha || ṃo_2,14.20 ||
"ekānte" janarahite deśe | sthitaḥ "jaraddrumaḥ" | tasya "sadharmakam" sadṛśam | "sādhukāryeṣu" cittanirodhādiṣu | phaladānena paropakārarūpeṣu ca śubhakāryeṣu || ṃoṭ_2,14.20 ||



viviktaṃ hi mano jantorāśāvaivaśyavarjitam |
parāṃ nirvṛtimabhyeti pūrṇaścandra ivātmani || ṃo_2,14.21 ||
"viviktam" vivekayuktam | "āśāvaivaśyavarjitam" iti viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa hetuḥ | āśāvaivaśyasyaiva nirvṛtirodhakatvāt || ṃoṭ_2,14.21 ||


vivekitoditā dehaṃ sarvaṃ śītalayatyalam |
alaṃkaroti cātyantaṃ jyotsneva bhuvanaṃ navā || ṃo_2,14.22 ||
"navā" śaratkālīnā || ṃoṭ_2,14.22 ||


paramārthapatākāyā dhiyo dhavalacāmaram |
vicāro rājate janto rajanyāmiva candramāḥ || ṃo_2,14.23 ||
"paramārthasya" śuddhacinmātratattvākhyaparamārthasya | "patākāyāḥ" pradarśakatvasāmānyena cihṇabhūtapatākārūpāyāḥ "dhiyaḥ" | "dhavalacāmaram" śobhādāyakatvena dhavalacāmararūpam || ṃoṭ_2,14.23 ||



vicāracāravo bhāvā bhāsayanto diśo daśa |
bhānti bhāskaravadbhagnabhūyobhavabhayāmayāḥ || ṃo_2,14.24 ||
"bhāvāḥ" manuṣyādirūpāḥ padārthāḥ | "bhāvāḥ" kathaṃbhūtāḥ | "bhagnāḥ bhūyāṃsi bhavabhayāni" ev"āmayāḥ" yaiḥ te | "bhāskaro"'pi "daśa diśaḥ" bhāsayati || ṃoṭ_2,14.24 ||


bālasya svamanomohakalpitaḥ prāṇahārakaḥ |
rātrau tamasi vetālo vicāreṇa vilīyate || ṃo_2,14.25 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,14.25 ||


sarva eva jagadbhāvā avicāreṇa cāravaḥ |
avidyamānasadbhāvā vicāraviśarāravaḥ || ṃo_2,14.26 ||
"sarva eva jagadbhāvāḥ" jagatpadārthāḥ | "avicāreṇa" vicārarāhityena | "cāravaḥ" bhavanti | kathaṃbhūtāḥ | "avidyamānasadbhāvāḥ" | ata eva ca "vicāraviśarāravaś" ca vicārāsahatvāt || ṃoṭ_2,14.26 ||



puṃso nijamanomohakalpito'nalpaduḥkhadaḥ |
saṃsāraciravetālo vicāreṇa vilīyate || ṃo_2,14.27 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,14.27 ||


samasvacchaṃ nirābādhamanantamananāśrayam |
viddhīmaṃ kevalībhāvaṃ vicāro'grataroḥ phalam || ṃo_2,14.28 ||
samaṃ ca tatsvacchaṃ "samasvacchaṃ" | "nirābādham" kenāpi pramāṇena bādhayitumaśakyam | "anantasyā"paricchinnasya svātmatattvasya | yat"mananam" parāmarśaḥ | tasy"āśrayam" lakṣaṇayā sādhakam || ṃoṭ_2,14.28 ||


acalasthitinodāraprakaṭābhogatejasā |
tena niṣkāmatodeti śītatevoditendunā || ṃo_2,14.29 ||
"udāraprakaṭābhogaṃ" udbhaṭaprakaṭavistāram | "tejaḥ" yasya | tādṛśena | "niṣkāmatā" kāmanārāhityam | "uditaś" cāsāv"induḥ" | tena || ṃoṭ_2,14.29 ||


nanu niṣkāmatayā kiṃ setsyatīty | atrāha
cintājvaramahauṣadhyā sādhuścittaniṣaṇṇayā |
tayottamatvapradayā nābhivāñchati nojjhati || ṃo_2,14.30 ||
"tayā" niṣkāmatayā | "nābhivāñchati nojjhati" sarvatropekṣāmeva bhajate ityarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.30 ||


punaḥ kiṃ karotīty | atrāha
tatsadālambanaṃ cetaḥ sphāramābhāsamāgatam |
nāstameti na codeti khamivātitatāntaram || ṃo_2,14.31 ||
sā niṣkāmatā "sadā ālambanam" āśrayo yasya | tat"tatsadālambanam" | tathā "sphāraṃ" sphuraṇaśīlam | "ābhāsamāgatam" vivekayuktaṃ jātamityarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.31 ||


na jahāti na cādatte nottāmyati na śāmyati |
kevalaṃ sākṣivatpaśyañjagadātmani tiṣṭhati || ṃo_2,14.32 ||
"nottāmyati" na kṣubhyati || ṃoṭ_2,14.32 ||



na ca śāmyati nāpyantarnāpi bāhye'vatiṣṭhati |
na ca naiṣkarmyamādatte na ca karmāṇi majjati || ṃo_2,14.33 ||
sarvatropekṣayaiva vartate iti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.33 ||


upekṣate gataṃ vastu saṃprāptamanuvartate |
na kṣubdho nāti cākṣubdho bhāti pūrṇa ivārṇavaḥ || ṃo_2,14.34 ||
"anuvartate" niranusandhānaṃ pravartate | "ati" atiśayena || ṃoṭ_2,14.34 ||


evaṃrūpeṇa manasā mahātmāno mahāśayāḥ |
jīvanmuktā jagatyasmin viharanti hi yoginaḥ || ṃo_2,14.35 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,14.35 ||


uṣitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ dhīrāste yāvadīpsitam |
tanumante parityajya yānti kevalatāṃ tatām || ṃo_2,14.36 ||
"kevalatām" videhamuktatām | "yāvadīpsitam" ityanena sarvameva bhagavatkṛtaṃ teṣāmīpsitamevāstīti sūcitam || ṃoṭ_2,14.36 ||


ko'haṃ kasya ca saṃsāra ityāpadyapi dhīmatā |
cintanīyaṃ prayatnena sapratīkāramātmanā || ṃo_2,14.37 ||
kimuta vaktavyaṃ saṃpadīty"api"śabdābhiprāyaḥ | "sapratīkāram" pratīkārasahitam | na tu cintanamātreṇaiva | pratīkāraścātra bhogatyāga eva jñeyaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.37 ||


kāryasaṃkaṭasandehaṃ rājā jānāti rāghava |
niṣphalaṃ saphalaṃ vāpi vicāreṇaiva nānyathā || ṃo_2,14.38 ||
bahirapi vicārasyaiva sāmrājyamiti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.38 ||


vedavedāntasiddhāntasthitayaḥ sthitikāraṇam |
nirṇīyante vicāreṇa dīpeneva bhuvo niśi || ṃo_2,14.39 ||
vedavedāntarūpāḥ sthitayaḥ maryādāḥ "vedavedāntasthitayaḥ" | "sthitikāraṇam" saṃsāramaryādākāraṇabhūtāḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.39 ||



anaṣṭamandhakāreṣu bahutejassvajihmitam |
paśyatyapi vyavahitaṃ vicāraścārulocanam || ṃo_2,14.40 ||
"ajihmitam" tejo'bhimukhe hi cakṣuṣi pratīghātena jihmitatvaṃ parivartitatvaṃ bhavati | taccātra nāstītyarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.40 ||


vivekāndho hi jātyandhaḥ śocyaḥ sarvasya durmatiḥ |
divyacakṣurvivekātmā jayatyakhilavastuṣu || ṃo_2,14.41 ||
"sarvasya śocyaḥ" sarvaiḥ śocanīya ityarthaḥ | "vivekaḥ ātmā" pradhānaṃ yasya saḥ "vivekātmā" vivekānvita ityarthaḥ | "jayati" sarvotkarṣeṇa vartate ityarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.41 ||


paramātmamayī pālyā mahānandaikasādhanī |
kṣaṇamekaṃ parityājyā na vicāracamatkṛtiḥ || ṃo_2,14.42 ||
"pālyā" rakṣaṇīyā || ṃoṭ_2,14.42 ||


vicāracāruḥ puruṣo mahatāmapi rocate |
paripakvaṃ camatkāri sahakāraphalaṃ yathā || ṃo_2,14.43 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,14.43 ||


vicārakāntamatayo nānekeṣu punaḥ punaḥ |
luṭhanti duḥkhaśvabhreṣu jñātordhvagatayo narāḥ || ṃo_2,14.44 ||
"jñātāḥ" adhigatā | "ūrdhve" uttīrṇe cinmātre | "gatiḥ" yaite || ṃoṭ_2,14.44 ||


na virauti tathā rogī nānarthaśatajarjaraḥ |
avicāravinaṣṭātmā yathājñaḥ pariroditi || ṃo_2,14.45 ||
"nānarthaśatajarjara" ityatra "ca"śabdo'dhyāhāryaḥ | "avicāreṇā"vivekena "vinaṣṭaḥ" vismṛtaḥ | "ātmā" pāramārthikaṃ svarūpaṃ yasya | tādṛśaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.45 ||


varaṃ kardamakīṭatvaṃ śvabhrakaṇṭakatā varam |
varamandhaguhāhitvaṃ na narasyāvicāritā || ṃo_2,14.46 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,14.46 ||


sarvānarthanijāvāsaṃ sarvasādhutiraskṛtam |
sarvadauḥsthityasīmāntamavicāraṃ parityajet || ṃo_2,14.47 ||
"sarve" ye "anarthāḥ" | teṣāṃ "nijaḥ" svakīyaḥ | "āvāsaḥ" sarvānarthaśrayamityarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.47 ||


nityaṃ vicārayuktena bhavitavyaṃ mahātmanā |
bhavāndhakūpe patatāṃ vicāro hyavalambanam || ṃo_2,14.48 ||
"hi" yasmādarthe | "avalambanam" ādhāraḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.48 ||


svayamevātmanātmānamavaṣṭabhya vicārataḥ |
saṃsāramohajaladhestārayetsvamanomṛgam || ṃo_2,14.49 ||
"ātmanā" manasā | "ātmānaṃ" paramātmānam | "avaṣṭabhya" bhāvanayā gṛhītvā || ṃoṭ_2,14.49 ||


vicārasya svarūpaṃ kathayati
ko'haṃ kathamayaṃ doṣaḥ saṃsārākhya upāgataḥ |
nyāyeneti parāmarśo vicāra iti kathyate || ṃo_2,14.50 ||
"nyāyena" yuktyā | "parāmarśaḥ" santatabhāvanam || ṃoṭ_2,14.50 ||


andhāndhamohamukharaṃ ciraṃ duḥkhāya kevalam |
kṛtaṃ śilāyā hṛdayaṃ durmateścāvicāriṇaḥ || ṃo_2,14.51 ||
atiṣayenāndham "andhāndham" | tādṛśaṃ ca tat"mohamukharaṃ" ca | jāḍyena viparyāsayuktamityarthaḥ | "duḥkhāya" svasya parasya ceti jñeyam || ṃoṭ_2,14.51 ||



bhāvābhāvagrahotsargadṛśāmiha hi rāghava |
na vicārādṛte tattvaṃ jñāyate  sādhu kiṃcana || ṃo_2,14.52 ||
"grahaḥ" grahaṇam | "utsargaḥ" tyāgaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,14.52 ||



vicārājjñāyate tattvaṃ tattvādviśrāntirātmani |
tato manasi śāntatvaṃ sarvaduḥkhaparikṣayaḥ || ṃo_2,14.53 ||
"tattvam" cinmātrākhyaṃ paramaṃ tattvam | "ātmani" śuddhacinmātrarūpe ātmani | "śāntatvasya" svarūpaṃ kathayati | "sarve"ti | "sarvaduḥkhakṣayasyai"va śāntirūpatvāt || ṃoṭ_2,14.53 ||

sargāntaślokena vicāranirūpaṇaṃ samāpayati
saphalatā phalate bhuvi karmaṇāṃ
prakaṭatāṃ kila gacchata uttamāt |
sphuṭavicāradṛśaiva vicāritā
śamavate bhavate'pi virocatām || ṃo_2,14.54 ||
"kila" niścaye | "bhuvi karmaṇāṃ saphalatā phalate" | "sphuṭavicāradṛśaiva" "sphuṭā" yā "vicāradṛk" | tayaiva | "uttamāt" viśeṣataḥ | "prakaṭatāṃ" "gacchataḥ" vivekasyaiva sarvaprakaṭane śaktatvāt | ataḥ iyaṃ "vicāritā" "śamavate bhavate'pi virocatām" | iti śivam || ṃoṭ_2,14.54 ||




iti śrībhāskarakaṇṭhaviracitāyāṃ śrīmokṣopāyaṭīkāyāṃ mumukṣuprakaraṇe caturdaśaḥ sargaḥ || 2,14 ||


************************************************************************

omevaṃ vicārasvarūpaṃ nirṇīya tṛtīyasya saṃtoṣasya svarūpaṃ kathayati
saṃtoṣo'pi paraṃ śreyaḥ saṃtoṣaḥ sukhamucyate |
saṃtuṣṭaḥ paramabhyeti viśrāmamarisūdana || ṃo_2,15.1 ||
"saṃtuṣṭaḥ" saṃtoṣayuktaḥ puruṣaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,15.1 ||


saṃtoṣaiśvaryasukhināṃ ciraviśrāntacetasām |
sāmrājyamapi sādhūnāṃ jarattṛṇalavāyate || ṃo_2,15.2 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,15.2 ||


saṃtoṣaśālinī buddhī rāma saṃsāravṛttiṣu |
viṣamāsvapyanudvignā na kadācana dūyate || ṃo_2,15.3 ||
"na dūyate" saṃtapyate saṃtuṣṭavān || ṃoṭ_2,15.3 ||


saṃtoṣāmṛtapānena ye parāṃ tṛptimāgatāḥ |
bhogaśrīratulā teṣāmeṣā prativiṣāyate || ṃo_2,15.4 ||
prativiṣā ivācarate "prativiṣāyate" | prativiṣā tiktadravyaviśeṣaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,15.4 ||


na tathā tarpayantyetāḥ pīyūṣarasavīcayaḥ |
yathā hi madhurāsvādaḥ saṃtoṣo doṣanāśanaḥ || ṃo_2,15.5 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,15.5 ||


saṃtuṣṭasvarūpakathanadvāreṇa saṃtoṣasvarūpaṃ kathayati
aprāptavāñchāmutsṛjya saṃprāpte samatāṃ gataḥ |
adṛṣṭakhedākhedo'ntaḥ sa saṃtuṣṭa ihocyate || ṃo_2,15.6 ||
"saṃprāpte" pravāhāgate || ṃoṭ_2,15.6 ||


ātmanātmani saṃtoṣaṃ yāvadyāti na mānasam |
udbhavantyāpadastāvallatā iva manovanāt || ṃo_2,15.7 ||
"ātmanā" svena | na tu bhogādinā || ṃoṭ_2,15.7 ||


saṃtoṣaśītalaṃ cetaḥ śuddhavijñānadṛṣṭibhiḥ |
bhṛśaṃ vikāsamāyāti sūryāṃśubhirivāmbujam || ṃo_2,15.8 ||
saṃtuṣṭasyaiva jñāne adhikāra iti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,15.8 ||


āśāvaivaśyavivaśe citte saṃtoṣavarjite |
mlāne vaktramivādarśe na jñānaṃ pratibimbati || ṃo_2,15.9 ||
"pratibimbati" lagati || ṃoṭ_2,15.9 ||



ajñānaghanayāminyā saṃkocaṃ na narāmbujam |
yātyasāvudito yasya nityaṃ saṃtoṣabhāskaraḥ || ṃo_2,15.10 ||
tat"narāmbujamajñānaghanayāminyā saṃkocaṃ na yāti" | tatkim | "yasyāsau saṃtoṣabhāskaraḥ nityamudito" bhavati || ṃoṭ_2,15.10 ||


akiṃcano'pyasau jantuḥ sāmrājyasukhamaśnute |
ādhivyādhivinirmuktaṃ saṃtuṣṭaṃ yasya mānasam || ṃo_2,15.11 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,15.11 ||


nābhivāñchatyasaṃprāptaṃ prāptaṃ bhuṅkte yathākramam |
yaḥ sasomyaḥ sadācāraḥ saṃtuṣṭa iti kathyate || ṃo_2,15.12 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,15.12 ||


saṃtoṣaparitṛptasya mahataḥ pūrṇacetasaḥ |
kṣīrābdheriva śuddhasya mukhe lakṣmīrvirājate || ṃo_2,15.13 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,15.13 ||


pūrṇatāmalamāśritya svātmanyevātmanā svayam |
pauruṣeṇa prayatnena tṛṣṇāṃ sarvatra varjayet || ṃo_2,15.14 ||
"pūrṇatāṃ" tṛptatām | "ātmanā eva" | na tu bhogairityarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,15.14 ||


saṃtoṣāmṛtapūrṇasya svāntaḥ śītalatā svayam |
sthairyamāyātyariktasya śītāṃśoriva śāśvatam || ṃo_2,15.15 ||
"svāntaḥ" svamanasi | "ariktasya" pūrṇasya || ṃoṭ_2,15.15 ||


saṃtoṣapuṣṭamanasaṃ bhṛtyā iva maharddhayaḥ |
rājānamupatiṣṭhante kiṃkaratvamupāgatāḥ || ṃo_2,15.16 ||
yathā "kiṃkaratvamupāgatāḥ bhṛtyāḥ rājānamupatiṣṭhante" tathā "saṃtoṣapuṣṭamanasaṃ" "maharddhayaḥ upatiṣṭhante" || ṃoṭ_2,15.16 ||



ātmanaivātmani svacche saṃtuṣṭe puruṣe sthite |
praśāmyantyādhayaḥ sarve prāvṛṣīvāśu pāṃsavaḥ || ṃo_2,15.17 ||
"svacche" rāgādimalarahite || ṃoṭ_2,15.17 ||


nityaṃ śītalayā nāma kalaṅkaparihīnayā |
puruṣaḥ śuddhayā vṛttyā bhāti pūrṇatayenduvat || ṃo_2,15.18 ||
"nāma" niścaye | "kalaṅkahīnayā" asantoṣākhyamalarahitayā || ṃoṭ_2,15.18 ||


saṃtoṣavivecanaṃ sargāntaślokena samāpayati
samatayā matayā guṇaśālināṃ
puruṣarāḍiha yaḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ |
tamamalaṃ praṇamanti nabhaścarā
api mahāmunayo raghunandana || ṃo_2,15.19 ||
spaṣṭam | iti śivam || ṃoṭ_2,15.19 ||


iti śrībhāskarakaṇṭhaviracitāyāṃ śrīmokṣopāyaṭīkāyāṃ mumukṣuprakaraṇe pañcadaśaḥ sargaḥ || 2,15 ||


************************************************************************

omevaṃ saṃtoṣasvarūpaṃ nirṇīya caturthaṃ satsaṃgaṃ nirūpayati
viśeṣeṇa mahābuddhe saṃsārottaraṇe nṛṇām |
sarvatropakarotīha sādhuḥ sādhusamāgamaḥ || ṃo_2,16.1 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.1 ||


sādhusaṃgatarorjātaṃ vivekakusumaṃ śubham |
rakṣanti ye mahātmāno bhājanaṃ te phalaśriyaḥ || ṃo_2,16.2 ||
"phalaśriyaḥ" mokṣākhyaphalalakṣmyāḥ || ṃoṭ_2,16.2 ||


śūnyamākīrṇatāmeti mṛtirapyutsavāyate |
āpatsaṃpadivābhāti vidvajjanasamāgame || ṃo_2,16.3 ||
"śūnyaṃ" śūnyadeśaḥ | "ākīrṇatām" lokabharitadeśatām || ṃoṭ_2,16.3 ||



himamāpatsarojinyā mohanīhāramārutaḥ |
jayatyeko jagatyasmin sādhu sādhusamāgamaḥ || ṃo_2,16.4 ||
"sādhu" samyak || ṃoṭ_2,16.4 ||



paraṃ vivardhanaṃ buddherajñānatarunāśanam |
samutsāraṇamādhīnāṃ viddhi sādhusamāgamam || ṃo_2,16.5 ||
"samutsāraṇam" nāśanam || ṃoṭ_2,16.5 ||


vivekaḥ paramo dīpo jāyate sādhusaṃgamāt |
manoharojjvalo nūnamaśokādiva gucchakam || ṃo_2,16.6 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.6 ||


nirāmayāṃ nirābādhāṃ nirvṛtiṃ nityapīvarīṃ  |
anuttamāṃ prayacchanti sādhusaṃgavibhūtayaḥ || ṃo_2,16.7 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.7 ||



api kaṣṭatarāṃ prāptairdaśāṃ vivaśatāṃ gataiḥ |
manāgapi na saṃtyājyā mānavaiḥ sādhusaṃgatiḥ || ṃo_2,16.8 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.8 ||


sādhusaṃgatayo loke sanmārgaśubhadīpakāḥ |
hārdāndhakārahāriṇyo bhāso jñānavivasvataḥ || ṃo_2,16.9 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.9 ||


yaḥ snātaḥ śītasitayā sādhusaṃgatigaṅgayā |
kiṃ tasya dānaiḥ kiṃ tīrthaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiḥ kimadhvaraiḥ || ṃo_2,16.10 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.10 ||



nīrāgāśchinnasaṃdehā galitagranthayo'nagha |
sādhavo yadi vidyante kiṃ tapastīrthasaṃgrahaiḥ || ṃo_2,16.11 ||
"galitagranthayaḥ" naṣṭakāmākhyagranthayaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,16.11 ||



viśrāntamanaso vandyāḥ prayatnena pareṇa hi |
daridreṇeva maṇayaḥ prekṣaṇīyā hi sādhavaḥ || ṃo_2,16.12 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.12 ||


satsamāgamasaundaryaśālinī dhīmatāṃ matiḥ |
kamalevāpsarovṛnde sarvadaiva virājate || ṃo_2,16.13 ||
"kamalā" lakṣmīḥ || ṃoṭ_2,16.13 ||


tenāmalavilāsasya padasyāgrāvacūlatā |
grathitā yena bhavyena na tyaktā sādhusaṃgatiḥ || ṃo_2,16.14 ||
"tena" puruṣeṇa | "amalavilāsasya" śuddhasphuraṇayuktasya | "padasya" cinmātrākhyasya sthānasya | "agrāvacūlatā" śirobhūṣaṇatā | "grathitā yena bhavyena" daivaprakṛtikena | "sādhusaṃgatiḥ na tyaktā" sādhusaṃgatiḥ kāryaiva cinmātrākhye pade rājate iti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,16.14 ||



vicchinnagranthayastajjñāḥ sādhavaḥ sarvasammatāḥ |
sarvopāyena saṃsevyāste hyupāyā bhavāmbudhau || ṃo_2,16.15 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.15 ||



ta ete narakāgnīnāṃ saṃśuṣkendhanatāṃ gatāḥ |
yairdṛṣṭā helayā santo narakānalavāridāḥ || ṃo_2,16.16 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.16 ||


dāridryaṃ maraṇaṃ duḥkhamityādiviṣamo bhramaḥ |
saṃpraśāmyatyaśeṣeṇa sādhusaṃgamabheṣajaiḥ || ṃo_2,16.17 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.17 ||


sarvānupāyān saṃkalpayati
saṃtoṣaḥ sādhusaṃgaśca vicāro'tha śamastathā |
eta eva bhavāmbhodhāvupāyāstaraṇe nṛṇām || ṃo_2,16.18 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.18 ||


saṃtoṣaḥ paramo lābhaḥ satsaṃgaḥ paramā gatiḥ |
vicāraḥ paramaṃ jñānaṃ śamo hi paramaṃ sukham || ṃo_2,16.19 ||
ataḥ paraṃ lābhādi nāstīti "para"padābhiprāyaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,16.19 ||

catvāra ete vimalā upāyā bhavabhedane |
yairabhyastāsta uttīrṇā mohavārerbhavārṇavāt || ṃo_2,16.20 ||
"mohavāreḥ" mohākhyajalayuktāt || ṃoṭ_2,16.20 ||


ekasminneva caiteṣāmabhyaste vimalodaye |
catvāro'pi kilābhyastā bhavanti sudhiyāṃ vara || ṃo_2,16.21 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.21 ||


eko'pyeko'pi sarveṣāmeṣāṃ prasavabhūriva |
sarvasaṃsiddhaye tasmādyatnenaikaṃ samāśrayet || ṃo_2,16.22 ||
"prasavabhūḥ" utpattisthānam || ṃoṭ_2,16.22 ||


satsamāgamasaṃtoṣavicārāstvavicāritam |
pravartante śamasvacche vahanānīva sāgare || ṃo_2,16.23 ||
"vahanāni" jalaspandāḥ | "avicāritam" asandeham || ṃoṭ_2,16.23 ||


vicārasaṃtoṣaśamāḥ satsamāgamaśālini |
pravartante śriyo jantau kalpavṛkṣāśrite yathā || ṃo_2,16.24 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.24 ||


vicāraśamasatsaṃgāḥ saṃtoṣavati mānave |
pravartante prapūrṇendau saundaryādyā guṇā iva || ṃo_2,16.25 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.25 ||



satsaṃgasaṃtoṣaśamā vicāravati sanmatau |
pravartante mantrivare rājanīva jayaśriyaḥ || ṃo_2,16.26 ||
"mantriṇāṃ" mantrajñānām | "vare" śreṣṭhe || ṃoṭ_2,16.26 ||


phalitamāha
tasmādekatamaṃ nityameteṣāṃ raghunandana |
pauruṣeṇa mano jitvā yatnenābhyāharedguṇam || ṃo_2,16.27 ||
"tasmāteteṣāṃ" caturṇāṃ madhye | "ekatamaṃ guṇaṃ" saṃtoṣādirūpaṃ guṇam | "abhyāharet" arjayet || ṃoṭ_2,16.27 ||



paraṃ pauruṣamāśritya jitvā cittamataṅgajam |
yāvadeko guṇo nāptastāvannāstyuttamā gatiḥ || ṃo_2,16.28 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.28 ||


pauruṣeṇa prayatnena dantairdantān vicūrṇayan |
yāvannābhiniviṣṭaṃ te mano rāma guṇārjane || ṃo_2,16.29 ||
devo bhavātha yakṣo vā puruṣaḥ pādapo'tha vā |
tāvattava mahābāho nopāyo'stīha kaścana || ṃo_2,16.30 ||
"guṇārjane" saṃtoṣādyarjane || ṃoṭ_2,16.2930 ||


ekasminneva phalite guṇe balamupāgate |
kṣīyante sarva evāśu doṣā viṣadacetasaḥ || ṃo_2,16.31 ||
"doṣāḥ" rāgādayaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,16.31 ||



guṇe vivṛddhe vardhante guṇā doṣakṣayāvahāḥ |
doṣe vivṛddhe vardhante doṣā guṇavināśinaḥ || ṃo_2,16.32 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.32 ||


manomahāvane hyasmin veginī vāsanāsarit |
śubhāśubhabṛhatkūlā nityaṃ vahati jantuṣu || ṃo_2,16.33 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,16.33 ||


sā hi svena prayatnena yasminneva nipātyate |
kūle tenaiva vahati yathecchasi tathā kuru || ṃo_2,16.34 ||
"hi" niścaye | "sā" vāsanāsarit || ṃoṭ_2,16.34 ||


sargāntaślokenaitatsamāpayati
puruṣayatnajavena manovane
śubhataṭānugatāṃ kramaśaḥ kuru |
varamate nijabhāvamahānadīm
iha hi tena manāgapi nohyase || ṃo_2,16.35 ||
"puruṣayatnajavena" pauruṣavegena | "nijabhāvanadīṃ" svavāsanā"mahānadīṃ" | nanu kimarthaṃ tāṃ taṭagatāṃ karomītyapekṣāyāmāha | "iha hī"ti | "hi" yasmāt | "tena" tasyāḥ "śubhataṭānugamanena" | tayā nijabhāvamahānadyā tvam "na uhyase" vivaśatayā yatra tatra na nīyase | taṭagatayā ca nadyā na kiṃcituhyate | iti śivam || ṃoṭ_2,16.35 ||




iti śrībhāskarakaṇṭhaviracitāyāṃ śrīmokṣopāyaṭīkāyāṃ mumukṣuprakaraṇe ṣoḍaśaḥ sargaḥ || 2,16 ||


************************************************************************

phalitaṃ kathayati
evamāttaviveko yaḥ sa bhavāniva rāghava |
yogyo jñānagiraḥ śrotuṃ rājeva nayabhāratīḥ || ṃo_2,17.1 ||
he "rāghava" | "evaṃ" sati | "yaḥ" puruṣaḥ | "āttaviveko" bhavati | "saḥ" | "bhavāniva" | "jñānagiraḥ śrotuṃ yogyo" bhavati| ka iva | "rājā iva" yathā "rājā nayabhāratīḥ" nītivākyāni "śrotuṃ yogyaḥ" bhavati | tathetyarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,17.1 ||



avadāto'vadātasya vijñānasya mahāśayaḥ |
jaḍasaṅgojjhito yogyaḥ śaradīndoryathā nabhaḥ || ṃo_2,17.2 ||
"avadātaḥ" śamādisevanena rāgādimalarahitaḥ nirmalaśca | "avadātasya" śuddhacinmātraviṣayatvena śuddhasya sitasya ca | "jaḍasaṅgena" mūḍhasaṅgen"ojjhitaḥ" tyaktaḥ | tamakurvāṇa ityarthaḥ | jaḍānāṃ lakṣaṇayā meghānāṃ "saṅgena ujjhitaḥ" iti ca || ṃoṭ_2,17.2 ||


tvametayākhaṇḍitayā guṇalakṣmyā samāśritaḥ |
manomohaharaṃ vākyaṃ vakṣyamāṇamidaṃ śṛṇu || ṃo_2,17.3 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,17.3 ||


puṇyakalpadrumo yasya phalabhārānataḥ sthitaḥ |
muktaye jāyate jantostasyedaṃ śrotumudyamaḥ || ṃo_2,17.4 ||
"idam" etatśāstram || ṃoṭ_2,17.4 ||


pāvanānāmudārāṇāṃ parabodhaikadāyinām |
vacasāṃ bhājanaṃ bhūtyai bhavyo bhavati nādhamaḥ || ṃo_2,17.5 ||
"bhavyaḥ" divyaprakṛtiḥ || ṃoṭ_2,17.5 ||



mokṣopāyābhidhāneyaṃ saṃhitā sārasammitā |
triṃśaddve ca sahasrāṇi jñātā nirvāṇadāyinī || ṃo_2,17.6 ||
"saṃhitā" śāstram | "sārasammitā" sāratulyā | "jñātā" samyakvicāritā || ṃoṭ_2,17.6 ||


nanu kimanayā setsyatīty | atrāha
dīpe yathā vinidrasya jvalite saṃpravartate |
āloko'nicchato'pyevaṃ nirvāṇamanayā bhavet || ṃo_2,17.7 ||
"yathā dīpe" pra"jvalite" | "anicchataḥ api" ālokānākāṅkṣiṇo'pi | ardha"nidrasyā"rdhaprabuddhasya | "ālokaḥ saṃpravartate" | "evamanayā" saṃhitayā | "nirvāṇam" brahmaṇyātyantiko layo | "bhavet" || ṃoṭ_2,17.7 ||



svayaṃ jñātā śrutā vāpi bhrāntiśāntyaiva saukhyadā |
āptoktivarṇitā sadyo yathāmṛtataraṅgiṇī || ṃo_2,17.8 ||
"āptoktivarṇite"ti "śrute"tyasya viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa hetuḥ |8|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
yathā rajjvāmahibhrāntirvinaśyatyavalokanāt |
tathaitatprekṣaṇācchāntimeti saṃsāraduḥkhitā || ṃo_2,17.9 ||
"etasyāḥ" saṃhitāyāḥ "prekṣaṇam" vicāraṇam "etatprekṣaṇam" | tasmāt ||9|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
yuktiyuktārthavākyāni kalpitāni pṛthakpṛthak |
dṛṣṭāntasārasūktāni cāsyāṃ prakaraṇāni ṣaṭ || ṃo_2,17.10 ||
mayā "ṣaṭprakaraṇāni asyāṃ kalpitāni" vihitāni| kathaṃbhūtāni | arthasahitāni vākyāni "arthavākyāni" | "yuktiyuktāni" arthavākyāni yeṣu | tāni| punaḥ kathaṃbhūtāni | "dṛṣṭāntaiḥ sāram" śreṣṭham "sūktaṃ" yeṣu | tāni ||10|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
prakaraṇaṣaṭkaṃ viśeṣato nirdiśati
vairāgyākhyaṃ prakaraṇaṃ prathamaṃ parikīrtitam |
vairāgyaṃ vardhate yena sekeneva marau taruḥ || ṃo_2,17.11 ||
nanu kiṃ tena saṃpadyata ity | atrāha | "vairāgyam" iti ||11|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
kiyatpramāṇaṃ tatkṛtamityapekṣāyāmāha
sārdhaṃ sahasraṃ granthasya yasmin hṛdi vicārite | |
prakāśā śuddhatodeti maṇāviva vimārjite || ṃo_2,17.12 ||
"granthasye"ti jātāvekavacanam| tatvairāgyaprakaraṇaṃ "granthasya" ślokānāṃ "sārdhaṃ sahasraṃ" bhavati| tatkim | "yasmin hṛdi vicārite" sati | "prakāśā" prakaṭā | "śuddhatā" rāgādimalarāhityaṃ "udeti" | kasminniva | "mārjite" śodhite "maṇau iva" | yathā "vimārjite maṇau śuddhatodeti" | tathetyarthaḥ ||12|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
mumukṣuvyavahārākhyaṃ tataḥ prakaraṇaṃ kṛtam |
sahasramātraṃ granthasya sūktigranthena sundaram || ṃo_2,17.13 ||
"sūkti"rūpaḥ yaḥ "granthaḥ" vākyam | tena "sundaram" | tadyuktamityarthaḥ ||13|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
nanu kiṃ tatra kathyate ity | atrāha
svabhāvo hi mumukṣūṇāṃ narāṇāṃ yatra varṇyate |
evaṃsvabhāvo mokṣasya yogya ityavagamyate || ṃo_2,17.14 ||
nanu varṇanena kiṃ setsyatīty | atrāha | "evaṃsvabhāva" iti ||14|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
athotpattiprakaraṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntākhyāyikāmayam |
pañcagranthasahasrāṇi vijñānapratipādanam || ṃo_2,17.15 ||
"vijñānapratipādanam" vijñānapratipādakamityarthaḥ ||15|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
jāgatī draṣṭṛdṛśyaśrīrahaṃ tvamitirūpiṇī |
anutthitaivotthiteva yatreti parivarṇyate || ṃo_2,17.16 ||
spaṣṭam ||16|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
yasmiñśrute jagadidaṃ śrotrāntarbudhyate'khilam |
sāsmadyuṣmatsavistāraṃ salokākāśaparvatam || ṃo_2,17.17 ||
piṇḍagrahavinirmuktaṃ nirbhittikamaparvatam |
pṛthvyādibhūtarahitaṃ saṃkalpa iva pattanam || ṃo_2,17.18 ||
"yasmin" yasminutpattiprakaraṇe | "sāsmadyuṣmat" ahaṃtvaṃyuktam | "budhyate" ity | atra "śrotre"ti kartṛtvenādhyāhāryam| kīdṛśaṃ budhyate ityapekṣāyāmāha | "piṇḍagrahe"tyādi | "saṃkalpe" hi "pattanam" īdṛgeva bhātīti dṛṣṭāntatvenopāttam  ||1718|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
punaḥ kīdṛgbudhyate ity | atrāha
svapnopalabdhabhāvābhaṃ manorājyavadātatam |
gandharvanagaraprakhyamarthaśūnyopalambanam || ṃo_2,17.19 ||
"svapnopalabdhabhāvābhaṃ" svapnadṛṣṭapadārthasadṛśamityarthaḥ | gandharvāḥ svāvāsārthaṃ kalpanayākāśe nagaraṃ kalpayanti | tadeva "gandharvanagaram" | "arthaśūnyaṃ" satyabhūtaghaṭādyartharahitam | "upalambanaṃ" jñānaṃ yasmin  ||19|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
dvicandravibhramābhāsaṃ mṛgatṛṣṇāmbuvattatam |
nauyānalolaśailābhaṃ satyalābhavivarjitam || ṃo_2,17.20 ||
spaṣṭam ||20|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
cittabhramapiśācābhaṃ nirbījamapi bhāsuram |
kathārthapratibhānābhaṃ vyomamuktāvalīnibham || ṃo_2,17.21 ||
"nirbījaṃ" kāraṇarahitam | "kathāyāḥ" yaḥ "arthaḥ" varṇanīyaḥ padārthaḥ | tasya yat"pratibhānaṃ" pura iva sphuraṇam | ten"ābhā" yasya | tat | kathāyāṃ hi varṇanīyaḥ padārthaḥ puraḥstha iva pratibhāti | "vyome"ti | bhrameṇa hi vyomni "muktāvalī" dṛśyate ||21|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
kaṭakatvaṃ yathā hemni taraṅgatvaṃ yathāmbhasi |
yathā nabhasi nīlatvamasadevotthitaṃ tathā || ṃo_2,17.22 ||
"kaṭakā"di "yathā hemni asadevotthitaṃ" bhavati "tathāsadevotthitaṃ" jagadbudhyate iti pūrveṇaiva sambandhaḥ ||22|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
abhitti raṅgarahitamupalabdhimanoharam |
svapne vā vyomni vā citramakarma cirabhāsuram || ṃo_2,17.23 ||
"vā"śabdadvayaṃ pakṣāntaradyotakam | "svapne" dṛṣṭaṃ "citram" "vā" budhyate | "vyomni" bhrameṇa dṛṣṭaṃ "citram" "vā" budhyate | citraṃ kathaṃbhūtam | "abhitti" bhittirahitam | tathā "raṅgarahitam" raṅgadravyarahitam | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtam | "akarma" anirmiti | tathā ciraṃ bhāsvaram "cirabhāsuram" | etaiḥ viśeṣaṇaiśca citrasya lokottaratvamuktam ||23|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
avahnireva vahnitvaṃ dhatte citrānalo yathā |
tathā dadhajjagacchabdarūpārthamasadātmakam || ṃo_2,17.24 ||
"tathā" tadvat | "asadātmakam" asatsvarūpam | "jagacchabdarūpārtham" bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ | jagaditi yacchabdarūpaṃ tasyārthatvaṃ "dadhat" budhyate "tathā" | katham | "yathā citrānalaḥ avahniḥ" adāhakatā anagniḥ san | "asadātmakaṃ vahnitvaṃ dhatte" dhārayati ||24|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
taraṅgotpalamālāḍhyadṛṣatpattramivotthitam |
cakraśūtkāracūrṇasya malarāśimivoditam || ṃo_2,17.25 ||
"taraṅgotpalamālābhiḥ āḍhyaṃ" yat"dṛṣatpattram" śilāpattram | tad"ivotthitaṃ" budhyate | śilāpattre hi taraṅgākāraḥ utpalākārāśca rekhāḥ bhavanti | tā evātra "taraṅgotpalamālāḥ" jñeyāḥ | padārthāścātra "taraṅgotpalamālāsthānīyāh" | punaḥ kīdṛgbudhyate ity | atrāha | "cakre"ti | "cakrasya" bhrāmyamāṇasya cakrasya | yat"śūtkāracūrṇam" | tasya "malarāśimiva uditaṃ" budhyate | bhrāmyamāṇena cakreṇa hi saśūtkāraṃ bhūmeḥ rajaḥ uttiṣṭhati ||25|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
śīrṇaparṇaṃ bhraṣṭanaṣṭaṃ grīṣme vanamivārasam |
maraṇavyagranṛttābhaṃ śilāstrīhāsyahāsadam || ṃo_2,17.26 ||
"śilāstrīhāsya"vat"hāsadam" ||26|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
andhakāragṛhaikaikanṛttamunmattaceṣṭitam |
praśāntājñānanīhāraṃ vijñānaśaradambaram || ṃo_2,17.27 ||
"andhakāragṛhe" yat"ekaikasya nṛttam" tadrūpaṃ budhyate | sarvathā cāsatyatarameva budhyate iti iha tāvadabhiprāyaḥ | itaḥ paraṃ cinmātramayaṃ cinmātrasthaṃ ca budhyata ityabhiprāyeṇāha | "praśānte"ti | śrotrā asminnutpattiprakaraṇe śrute sati idaṃ "praśāntājñānanīhāraṃ jñānaśaradambaraṃ" budhyate ||27|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
samutkīrṇamiva stambhe citraṃ bhittāvivāhitam |
paṅkādivābhiracitaṃ sacetanamacetanam || ṃo_2,17.28 ||
"stambhe" cinmātrākhye stambhe | "samutkīrṇamiva" budhyate | tathā "bhittau" cinmātrākhyāyāṃ bhittau | "citramivāhitaṃ" kṛtaṃ budhyate | "paṅko"'tra cinmātrasvarūpaṃ jñeyam | "sacetanaṃ" cinmātrasāratvāt | "acetanaṃ" grāhyatvāt ||28|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
tataḥ sthitiprakaraṇaṃ caturthaṃ parikalpitam |
trīṇi granthasahasrāṇi svākhyānākhyāyikāmayam || ṃo_2,17.29 ||
śobhanākhyāḥ "ākhyānākhyāyikāḥ" | tan"mayam" ||29|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
nanu sthitiprakaraṇe kimuktamity | atrāha
itthaṃ jagadahaṃbhāvarūpaṃ sthitimupāgatam |
draṣṭṛdṛśyakramaprauḍhamityatra parivarṇitam  || ṃo_2,17.30 ||
"ahaṃbhāvarūpasya" "jagataḥ" "sthitir" evātra prāyaśo nirṇīyate iti bhāvaḥ ||30|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
daśadiṅmaṇḍalābhogabhāsuro'yaṃ jagadbhramaḥ |
itthamabhyāgato vṛddhimiti tatrocyate ciram || ṃo_2,17.31 ||
"ciram" bahukālam | bāhulyeneti yāvat ||31|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
upaśāntiprakaraṇaṃ tataḥ pañcasahasrikam |
pañcamaṃ pāvanaṃ proktaṃ munisantatisundaram || ṃo_2,17.32 ||
"munisantatibhiḥ" dṛṣṭāntatayā vakṣyamāṇābhiḥ munisantatibhiḥ | "sundaram" ramaṇīyam ||32|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
nanvatra kiṃ varṇyata ityapekṣāyāmāha
idaṃ jagadahaṃ tvaṃ ca sa iti bhrāntirutthitā |
ityasau śāmyatītyasmin kathyate ślokasaṅgrahe || ṃo_2,17.33 ||
"idaṃ jagatahaṃ tvaṃ ca saḥ" | "iti" evaṃrūpā | "bhrāntiḥ utthitā" | iti satī eva | "śāmyati" | "iti" evam | "asmin" upaśāntiprakaraṇe "kathyate" | "asmin" kathaṃbhūte | "ślokānāṃ saṅgrahaḥ" yasmin saḥ | tādṛśe | "sa" iti paramakāraṇaparāmarśaḥ  ||33|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
nanvetacchravaṇena kiṃ setsyatīty | atrāha
upaśāntiprakaraṇe śrute śāmyati saṃsṛtiḥ |
praspaṣṭā vibhrameṇaiva kiṃcillabhyopalambhanā || ṃo_2,17.34 ||
"saṃsṛtiḥ" kathaṃbhūtā | "vibhrameṇaiva" viparyayajñānenaiva "praspaṣṭā" | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtā | "kiṃcit" leśena | "labhyamupalambhanaṃ" sparśaḥ yasyāḥ sā | anyathā nirvāṇaprakaraṇaṃ vyarthaṃ syātiti bhāvaḥ ||34|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
nanu tataḥ saṃsṛtiḥ kīdṛśī tiṣṭhatītyapekṣāyāmāha
śatāṃśaśiṣṭā bhavati saṃśāntabhrāntirūpiṇī |
anyasaṃkalpacittasthā nagaraśrīrivāsatī || ṃo_2,17.35 ||
spaṣṭam ||35|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
alabhyaiva svapārśvasthasvapnayuddhavirāvavat |
śāntasaṃkalpamattābhrabhīṣaṇāśaniśabdavat || ṃo_2,17.36 ||
saṃkalpe dṛṣṭaṃ mattābhram "saṃkalpamattābhram" | "śāntaṃ" yat"saṃkalpamattābhram" | tasya yaḥ "bhīṣaṇaḥ aśaniśabdaḥ" | tad"vat" ||36|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
vismṛtasvapnasaṃkalpanirmāṇanagaropamā |
bhaviṣyannagarodyānasotsavaśyāmalāṅgikā || ṃo_2,17.37 ||
"vismṛtau" yau "svapnasaṃkalpau" | tayoḥ "nirmāṇaṃ" yasya | tādṛśaṃ yat"nagaraṃ" | ten"opamā" yasyāḥ sā | tathā "bhaviṣyannagarodyāne sotsavā" samadanā | yā "śyāmalā" śyāmākhyā strī | tadvat"aṅgaṃ" svarūpaṃ yasyāṃ sā | tādṛśī ||37|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
naśyajjihvocyamānograkathārthānubhavopamam |
anullikhitacittasthacitravyāpteva bhittibhūḥ || ṃo_2,17.38 ||
punaḥ kathaṃbhūtā | "naśyajjihvena" | na tu naṣṭajihvena | "ucyamānā" yā "ugrakathā" | tasyāḥ yaḥ "arthaḥ" | tasya yaḥ "anubhavaḥ" | ten"opamā" yatra tat | tādrśam | kā iva | "anullikhitāni" "cittasthāni" ca tāni citrakṛc"cittasthāni" ca yāni "citrāṇi" | taiḥ "vyāptā bhittibhūriva" ||38|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
parivismāryamāṇācchakalpanānagarīnibhā |
sarvartumadanutpannavaramardāsphuṭākṛtiḥ || ṃo_2,17.39 ||
"parivismāryamāṇā" | na tu vismāritā | yā "acchā" bhittirahitā | "kalpanānagarī" | tasyāḥ "nibhā" sadṛśī | "sarvāsāmṛtumatīnāmanutpannasya" "varasya mardaḥ" mardanam | tadvat"asphuṭā ākṛtiḥ" yasyāḥ sā | nikaṭavartitvena buddhāvārūḍhatvajñāpanārthamṛtumatīnāmityuktam ||39|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
bhāvipuṣpavarākāravasantarasarañjanā |
antarlīnataraṅgaughasaumyavārisaritsamā || ṃo_2,17.40 ||
"bhāvī puṣpā"khyo "varākāraḥ" yasya saḥ | tādṛśo yaḥ "vasantarasaḥ" | tadvat"rañjanā" yasyāḥ sā | tatsadṛśītyarthaḥ | "antarlīnaḥ taraṅgaughaḥ" yasyāḥ sā "antarlīnataraṅgaughā" | tādṛśī cāsau "saumyavārisarit" saumyavāriyuktā nadī | tayā "samā" sadṛśī | etairviśeṣaṇaiścopaśāntiprakaraṇaśravaṇānantaraṃ buddhyārohamātrasvarūpā sṛṣṭistiṣṭhatīti sūcitam ||40|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
nirvāṇākhyaṃ prakaraṇaṃ tataḥ ṣaṣṭhamudāhṛtam |
śiṣṭo granthaḥ parīmāṇaṃ tasya jñeyaṃ mahārthadam || ṃo_2,17.41 ||
"tataḥ" upaśāntiprakaraṇānantaram | "śiṣṭaḥ granthaḥ" sārdhaṣoḍaśasahasrāṇi "parīmāṇam" ||41|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
nanu kiṃ tacchravaṇena setsyatīty | atrāha
buddhe tasmin bhavecchrotā nirvāṇaḥ śāntakalpanaḥ |
acetyacitprakāśātmā vijñānātmā nirāmayaḥ || ṃo_2,17.42 ||
"nirvāṇaḥ" brahmaṇi līnaḥ | "vijñānātmā" śuddhajñānasvarūpaḥ | "nirāmayaḥ" dṛśyākhyāmayarahitaḥ ||42|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
paramākāśakośācchaḥ śāntasarvabhavabhramaḥ |
nirvāhitajagadyātraḥ kṛtakartavyasusthitaḥ  || ṃo_2,17.43 ||
"nirvāhitā" avasānaṃ nītā "jagadyātrā" yena saḥ | tādṛśaḥ | "kṛtaṃ" samāptam | kartavyaṃ yena "kṛtakartavyaḥ" | tādṛśaścāsāv | ata eva "susthitaś" ca ||43|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
samastavitatārambhavajrastambho nabhonibhaḥ |
vinigīrṇayathāsaṃsthajagajjālātitṛptimān || ṃo_2,17.44 ||
"samastāḥ" ye "vitatārambhāḥ" | teṣu "vajrastambhaḥ" avicala ityarthaḥ | "nabhonibhaḥ" śarīrayātrārthaṃ kṛtairapi karmabhiraliptatvātākāśasadṛśaḥ | "vinigīrṇaṃ" citsvarūpe svātmani līnīkṛtam | yat"jagajjālaṃ" | ten"ātitṛptimān" nirapekṣa ityarthaḥ ||44|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
ākāśībhūtaniḥśeṣarūpālokamanaskṛtiḥ |
kāryakāraṇakartṛtvaheyādeyadaśojjhitaḥ || ṃo_2,17.45 ||
"rūpam" viṣayaḥ | "ālokaḥ" tadgrahaṇopāyaḥ | "manaskṛtiḥ" manaskāraḥ | ālokena gṛhītasya rūpasya manasi anusandhānamiti yāvat ||45|| ṃoṭ_2,17.
sadeha eva nirdehaḥ sasaṃsāro'pyasaṃsṛtiḥ |
cinmayo ||hanapāṣāṇajaṭharajaṭharopamaḥ || ṃo_2,17.46 ||
"sadehaḥ" sattvaśeṣaṃ tāvatśarīrasya sthitatvāt | "nirdehaḥ" śarīre'bhimānābhāvāt | "cinmayaḥ" citsvarūpa ahamiti niścayāt | "ghanapāṣāṇasya" yat"jaṭharam" | tasya yat"jaṭharam" | ten"opamā" yasya saḥ | tādṛśaḥ acetyacinmayatvāt || ṃoṭ_2,17.46 ||



cidādityastapaṃlloke'pyandhakārodaropamaḥ |
paraprakāśarūpo'pi paramāndhyamivāgataḥ || ṃo_2,17.47 ||
"cidādityaḥ" cidādityasvarūpaḥ | ata eva "loke tapannapi" | na hi citsparśarahitaḥ kaścitbhāvaḥ saṃbhavati | sattve'pi tasya asaṃkalpatvaprasaṅgāt | "andhakārodaropamaḥ" andhakārasya yatudaram | tenopamā yasya | tādṛśaḥ padārthavibhāgarahitatvāt | na hi andhakārodare padārthavibhāgaḥ bhavati | "paraprakāśarūpo'pi" uttīrṇacitprakāśarūpo'pi | "paramāndhyam" "āgataḥ iva" na kiṃciddraṣṭṛtvāt || ṃoṭ_2,17.47 ||



ruddhasaṃsṛtidurlīlaḥ prakṣīṇāśāviṣūcikāḥ |
naṣṭāhaṃkāravetālo dehavānakalevaraḥ || ṃo_2,17.48 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,17.48 ||


kasmiṃścidromakoṭyagre tasyeyamavatiṣṭhate |
jagallakṣmīrmahāmeroḥ puṣpe kvacidivālinī || ṃo_2,17.49 ||
"kaśmiṃscit" atisūkṣmatayā vaktumaśakye "svapnavad" iti śeṣaḥ | svapne hi puruṣasya kasmiṃścidaṃśe svapnajagad"avatiṣṭhate" || ṃoṭ_2,17.49 ||


paramāṇau paramāṇau cidākāśasya koṭare |
jagallakṣmīsahasrāṇi dhatte kṛtvā ca paśyati || ṃo_2,17.50 ||
"cidākāśasya" svarūpabhūtasya cinmātrākāśasya | "koṭare" madhye sthite | "paramāṇau paramāṇau jagallakṣmīsahasrāṇi kṛtvā dhatte" dhārayati | na kevalaṃ dhatte | kiṃ tu sākṣitayā sthitatvāt"paśyati ca" || ṃoṭ_2,17.50 ||


nanu kathamasau jagallakṣmīsahasrāṇyantarvartayatīty | atra sargāntaślokenāha
pravitatā hṛdayasya mahāmate
hariharābjajalakṣaśatairapi |
tulanameti na muktimato bata
pravitatāsti na nūnamavastunaḥ || ṃo_2,17.51 ||
"bata" niścaye | he "mahāmate" | "muktimataḥ" nirvāṇaprakaraṇaśravaṇadvāreṇa muktiyuktasya puruṣasya | "hṛdayasya pravitataḥ" bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ | tena "hṛdayasya pravitate"ti arthaḥ | sā "hariharābjajalakṣaśatairapi tulanaṃ" māpanaviṣayatāṃ "na eti" | yataḥ "avastunaḥ" avastubhūtasya hariharābjādirūpasya bhāvavṛndasya "pravitatā" | "nūnaṃ" niścaye | "nāsti" | na cāvastunā vastumāpanaṃ yuktam | tathā ca noktadeśaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | iti śivam || ṃoṭ_2,17.51 ||




iti śrībhāskarakaṇṭhaviracitāyāṃ śrīmokṣopāyaṭīkāyāṃ mumukṣuprakaraṇe saptadaśaḥ sargaḥ || 2,17 ||


************************************************************************

oṃ śrotṛpravṛttyarthaṃ svena kriyamāṇasya granthasyānyavilakṣaṇatvena samyagjñānaṃ prati paropāyatvaṃ kathayati
asyāṃ vācitamātrāyāṃ paro bodhaḥ pravartate |
bījādiva yato vyuptādavaśyaṃbhāvi satphalam || ṃo_2,18.1 ||
"asyāṃ" mokṣopāyābhidhāyāṃ saṃhitāyām | "bodhaḥ" kaḥ | "yataḥ" yasmātbodhāt | "satphalaṃ" mokṣākhyaṃ śubhaṃ phalam | "avaśyaṃbhāvi" bhavati | kasmādiva | "vyuptādbījādiva" || ṃoṭ_2,18.1 ||


nanu mahāmunipraṇītāni śāstrāntarāṇi tyaktvā kimiti idameva śāstraṃ gṛhṇāmīty | atrāha
api pauruṣamādeyaṃ śāstraṃ cedyuktibodhakam |
anyattvārṣamapi tyājyaṃ bhāvyaṃ nyāyaikasevinā || ṃo_2,18.2 ||
"pauruṣam" puruṣanirmitam | "ādeyaṃ" grahītavyam | "yuktibodhakam" sattarkabodhakam | "anyat" yuktyabodhakam | "ārṣam" ṛṣinirmitam | atra ca pratibhānvitaiḥ kaścidabhiprāyo boddhavyaḥ yo'smābhiḥ ārambha eva pratibhāvatāṃ svayaṃ jñeyatvena tadrahitānāmakathanīyatvena coktaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.2 ||



yuktiyuktamupādeyaṃ vacanaṃ bālakādapi |
anyattṛṇamiva tyājyamapyuktaṃ padmajanmanā || ṃo_2,18.3 ||
atrāpi pratibhāvadbhiḥ ārambhe svayaṃ jñeyatvenokto'rthaḥ svayaṃ boddhavyaḥ | na ca tadbodhenāsmiñśāstre anādaraḥ kāryaḥ pratibhāvattvahāneḥ | evamuttaratrāpi yatra tatra svayamabhyūhyam || ṃoṭ_2,18.3 ||


punarapyetadeva bhaṅgyantareṇa kathayati
yo'mbhastātasya kūpo'yamiti kaupaṃ pibetkaṭu |
tyaktvā gāṅgaṃ puraḥsthaṃ taṃ ko'nuśāsati rāgiṇam || ṃo_2,18.4 ||
"yaḥ" puruṣaḥ | "puraḥsthaṃ gāṅgaṃ" toyaṃ "tyaktvā" | "ayaṃ kūpaḥ tātasya" nijasya pituḥ bhavati | "iti" etadartham | "kaupaṃ" kūpasambandhi | "kaṭu ambhaḥ pibet" | "tam" anu"rāgiṇaṃ" pitṛviṣayarāgākhyadoṣayuktam | "kaḥ anuśāsati" upadiśati | nāsāvupadeśārhaḥ iti bhāvaḥ | ayamatrābhiprāyaḥ | "yaḥ" puruṣaḥ | sadyuktiyuktam "api pauruṣaṃ" vacanam | "pauruṣeyamidam" iti tyajati | tadrahitamapi "ārṣaṃ" vacanam | "ārṣam" ityetāvanmātreṇa gṛhṇāti | tasyopadeśo na kāryaḥ iti || ṃoṭ_2,18.4 ||



prakṛtamevānusarati
yathoṣasi pravṛttāyāmāloko'vaśyameṣyati |
asyāṃ vācitamātrāyāṃ svavivekastathaiṣyati || ṃo_2,18.5 ||
"uṣasī"tyārṣaṃ strītvam | "svavivekaḥ" ātmavivekaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.5 ||


śrutāyāṃ prājñavadanādbuddhāyāṃ svayameva vā |
śanaiḥ śanairvicāreṇa buddhau saṃskāra āgate || ṃo_2,18.6 ||
pūrvaṃ tāvadudetyantarbhṛśaṃ saṃskṛtavākyatā |
śuddhā muktā latevoccairyā sabhāsthānabhūṣaṇam || ṃo_2,18.7 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,18.67 ||


nanu viraktasya mama kiṃ saṃskṛtavākyatayā prayojanamity | atrāha
parā virāgatodeti mahattvaguṇaśālinī |
sā yayā snehamāyānti rājāno'jagarā api || ṃo_2,18.8 ||
virakteṣu hi "ajagara"tulyāḥ "rājāno'pi snehamāyānti" || ṃoṭ_2,18.8 ||


pūrvāparajñaḥ sarvatra naro bhavati buddhimān |
padārthānāṃ yathā dīpahasto niśi sulocanaḥ || ṃo_2,18.9 ||
"sarvatra" sarveṣu vyavahāreṣu || ṃoṭ_2,18.9 ||


lobhamohādayo doṣāstānavaṃ yāntyalaṃ śanaiḥ |
dhiyo diśaḥ samāsannaśarado mihikā yathā || ṃo_2,18.10 ||
"lobhamohādayaḥ" kāḥ | "yathā mihikāḥ" "samāsannaśaradaḥ" pratyāsannaśaratkālāyāḥ "diśaḥ tānavaṃ yānti" | tathetyarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.10 ||



kevalaṃ samapekṣante vivekābhyasanaṃ dhiyaḥ |
na kācana phalaṃ dhatte svabhyāsena vinā kriyā || ṃo_2,18.11 ||
nanu kimarthaṃ "vivekābhyāsamapekṣante" ity | atrāha | "na kācane"ti || ṃoṭ_2,18.11 ||


manaḥ prasādamāyāti śaradīva mahatsaraḥ |
paraṃ sāmyamupādhatte nirmandara ivārṇavaḥ || ṃo_2,18.12 ||
"prasādaṃ" rāgādimalarahitatvātnairmalyam | "param" niratiśayam | "sāmyaṃ" samatākhyaṃ guṇam | "upādhatte" dhārayati | atrāpi manasa eva kartṛtvam || ṃoṭ_2,18.12 ||


nirastakālimā vajraśikhevāstatamaḥpaṭā |
parijvalatyalaṃ prajñā padārthapravibhāginī || ṃo_2,18.13 ||
"nirastaḥ" dūre gataḥ | "kālimā" kāluṣam | yasyāḥ sā || ṃoṭ_2,18.13 ||


dainyadāridryadoṣādyā dṛṣṭayo darśitāntarāḥ |
na nikṛntanti marmāṇi sasaṃnāhamiveṣavaḥ || ṃo_2,18.14 ||
"darśitaṃ" vivecitam | antaraṃ sārākhyaḥ "āntaraḥ" bhāgaḥ yāsāṃ tāḥ | niḥsāratvena jñātā ityarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.14 ||


hṛdayaṃ nāvalumpanti bhīmāḥ saṃsṛtibhītayaḥ |
puraḥsthitamapi prājñaṃ mahopalamivākhavaḥ || ṃo_2,18.15 ||
"hṛdayaṃ" kathaṃbhūtam "api" | "puraḥsthitamapi" agre sthitamapi | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtam | "prājñam" || ṃoṭ_2,18.15 ||


kathaṃ syādāditā janmakarmaṇordaivapuṃstvayoḥ |
ityādisaṃśayagaṇaḥ śāmyatyahni yathā tamaḥ || ṃo_2,18.16 ||
"daivapuṃstvayoḥ" daivapauruṣayoḥ | "āditā" kāraṇatvam || ṃoṭ_2,18.16 ||


sarvathā sarvabhāveṣu saṃgatirupaśāmyati |
yāminyāmiva yātāyāṃ prajñāloka upāgate || ṃo_2,18.17 ||
"sarvabhāveṣu" tyāgādānārheṣu samasteṣu padārtheṣu | "sarvathā saṃgatiḥ" tyāgādānārūpā sambandhaḥ "upaśāmyati" | kasmin sati | "pra"ti"jñāloka upāgate" sati | kadeva | "yāminyāṃ" rātrau "yātāyāmiva" satyām | upekṣā eva sarvatrāyātīti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.17 ||


samudrasyeva gāmbhīryaṃ sthairyaṃ meroriva sthitam |
antaḥśītalatā cendorivodeti vicāriṇaḥ || ṃo_2,18.18 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,18.18 ||


sā jīvanmuktatā tasya śanaiḥ pariṇatiṃ gatā |
śāntāśeṣavikalpasya bhavatyāviśya yoginaḥ  || ṃo_2,18.19 ||
"sā" prasiddhā | "āviśya" āveśaṃ kṛtvā || ṃoṭ_2,18.19 ||



sarvārthaśītalā śuddhā paramālokadā sudhīḥ |
paraṃ prakāśamāyāti jyotsneva sakalaindavī || ṃo_2,18.20 ||
"sarvārtheṣu" bhāvābhāvayukteṣu samasteṣu pad"ārtheṣu" | "śītalā" harṣāmarṣākhyatāparahitā | "śuddhā" rāgādirahitā | "paramālokaṃ" cinmātrālokaṃ "dadhātī"ti tādṛśī | śobhanā cāsau dhīḥ "sudhīḥ" | "aindavī" indusambandhinī || ṃoṭ_2,18.20 ||


hṛdyākāśe vivekārke śamālokini nirmale |
anarthasārthakartāro nodyanti kaliketavaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.21 ||


"śama" eva "ālokaḥ" asyāstīti tādṛśe | "kaleḥ" kalahasya kṣobhasya | "ketavaḥ" cihnabhūtāḥ rāgādayo doṣāḥ | sūryodaye ca "ketavaḥ" dhūmaketavaḥ "nodyanti" || ṃoṭ_2,18.21 ||


śāmyanti śuddhimāyānti saumyāstiṣṭhanti sūnnate |
acañcalajaḍāstṛṣṇāḥ śaradīvābhramālikāḥ || ṃo_2,18.22 ||
na cañcalajaḍāḥ "acañcalajaḍāḥ" || ṃoṭ_2,18.22 ||


yatkiṃcanakarī krūrā grāmyatā vinivartate |
dīnānanā piśācānāṃ līleva divasāgame || ṃo_2,18.23 ||
"yatkiṃcanakarī" ayuktakāriṇī | "grāmyatayā" hi puruṣaḥ yatkiṃcideva karoti || ṃoṭ_2,18.23 ||



dharmabhittau bhṛśaṃ lagnāṃ dhiyaṃ dhairyadhuraṃ gatām |
ādhayo na vilumpanti vātāścitralatāmiva || ṃo_2,18.24 ||
"dharma" eva "bhittiḥ" | tasyāṃ "lagnāṃ" | ata eva "dhairyadhuraṃ gatām" dhairyayuktāmiti yāvat | dharmayukto hi dhīro bhavati | citrarūpā latā "citralatā" | tām || ṃoṭ_2,18.24 ||



na patatyavaṭe janturviṣayāsaṅgarūpiṇi |
kaḥ kila jñātasaraṇiḥ śvabhre samanudhāvati || ṃo_2,18.25 ||
"viṣayāsaṅgarūpiṇi" bhogāsaktirūpe | etadeva uttarārdhena samarthayati | "kaḥ kile"ti || ṃoṭ_2,18.25 ||



sacchāstrasādhuvṛttānāmavirodhini karmaṇi |
ramate dhīryathāprāpte sādhvīvāntaḥpurājire || ṃo_2,18.26 ||
"sacchāstreṇa" mokṣopāyākhyasacchāstrāvagāhanena "sādhuvṛttaṃ" caritaṃ yeṣāṃ te | tādṛśānām | "yathāprāpte" pravāhāgate | na tu yatnādṛte || ṃoṭ_2,18.26 ||


jagatāṃ koṭilakṣyeṣu yāvantaḥ paramāṇavaḥ |
teṣāmekaikaśo'ntaḥsthān sargān paśyatyasargadhīḥ || ṃo_2,18.27 ||
"asargā dhīḥ" yasya saḥ | āścaryaṃ cāsargadhiyaḥ paramāṇau paramāṇau sargadarśanam | sargabījabhūtacinmātravyāptijñānena paramāṇau paramāṇau sargadarśanaṃ jñeyam || ṃoṭ_2,18.27 ||


mokṣopāyāvabodhena śuddhāntaḥkaraṇaṃ janam |
na khedayati bhogaugho na cānandayati kvacit || ṃo_2,18.28 ||
bhogeṣūpekṣāmevāsau bhajate iti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.28 ||


paramāṇau paramāṇau sargavargā nirargalam |
ye patantyutpatantyambuvīcivattān sa paśyati || ṃo_2,18.29 ||
"patanti" līnā bhavanti | "utpatanti" prādurbhavanti || ṃoṭ_2,18.29 ||

na dveṣṭi saṃpravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati |
kāryāṇyeṣa prabuddho'pi niṣprabuddha iva drumaḥ || ṃo_2,18.30 ||
abuddhatvamasya svātmani "niṣprabuddhatvaṃ" saṃsāre jñeyam || ṃoṭ_2,18.30 ||


nanu kīdṛgatiśayo'sya syādity | atrāha
dṛśyate lokasāmānyo yathāprāptānuvṛttimān |
iṣṭāniṣṭaphalaprāptau hṛdaye na parājitaḥ || ṃo_2,18.31 ||
"lokasāmānyaḥ" na tvatiśayavān | "yathāprāpte" pravāhāgate | "anuvṛttiḥ" anuvartanam | vidyate yasya | saḥ "yathāprāptānuvṛttimān" | "hṛdaye" manasi | "na parājitaḥ" harṣāmarṣāvaśībhūtaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.31 ||



buddhvedamakhilaṃ śāstraṃ vācayitvā vivecya vā |
anubhūyata evaitanna tūktaṃ varaśāpavat || ṃo_2,18.32 ||
yuṣmābhiḥ "etat" pūrvoktaṃ phalaṃ "anubhūyata eva" | nanu pratyavāyaśaṅkayā kathametadanubhave śaktā bhavāma ityapekṣāyāmāha | "na tūktam" iti | "mantrādivad" iti śeṣaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.32 ||


nanu durbodhe'smin kathaṃ pravṛttiṃ kurma ity | atrāha
śāstraṃ subodhamevedaṃ nānālaṃkārabhūṣitam |
kāvyaṃ rasaghanaṃ cāru dṛṣṭāntaiḥ pratipādakam || ṃo_2,18.33 ||
"dṛṣṭāntaiḥ pratipādakam" iti subodhatve viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa hetuḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.33 ||


budhyate svayamevedaṃ kiṃcitpadapadārthavit |
svayaṃ yastu na vettīdaṃ śrotavyaṃ tena paṇḍitāt || ṃo_2,18.34 ||
"budhyate" jānāti | nanu yasya padapadārthavittvaṃ nāsti tasya kiṃ kāryamity | atrāha "svayam" iti || ṃoṭ_2,18.34 ||



nanvetacchravaṇena kiṃ setsyatīty | atrāha
asmiñśrute mate jñāte tapodhyānajapādikam |
mokṣaprāptau tu tasyeha na kiṃcidupayujyate || ṃo_2,18.35 ||
"śrute" śravaṇaviṣayatāṃ nīte | "mate" mananaviṣayatāṃ nīte | "jñāte" nidadhyāsite | "tasya" śravaṇādau pravṛttasya || ṃoṭ_2,18.35 ||


etacchāstraghanābhyāsātpaunaḥpunyena vīkṣitāt |
jantoḥ pāṇḍityapūrvaṃ hi cittasaṃskārapūrvakam || ṃo_2,18.36 ||
ahaṃ jagaditi prauḍho draṣṭṛdṛśyapiśācakaḥ  |
piśāco'rkodayeneva svayaṃ śāmyatyavighnataḥ || ṃo_2,18.37 ||
etena bāhyamapi prayojanamāntaramapi ca setsyatīti kathitam || ṃoṭ_2,18.3637 ||



bhramo jagadahaṃ ceti sthita evopaśāmyati |
svapnamohaḥ parijñāta iva no ramayatyalam || ṃo_2,18.38 ||
"sthita eva" | na tu mantrādiprayogavaśenāntarbhūtiṃ gataḥ | nanu sthitasyopaśamanaṃ kathamity | atrāha | "svapnamoha" iti | arasakasya sthitasyāpi śāntireva jñeyā kṣobhakāritvābhāvātiti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.38 ||


yathā saṃkalpanagare puṃso harṣaviṣāditā |
na bādhate tathaivāntaḥ parijñāte jagadbhrame || ṃo_2,18.39 ||
"antaḥ" manasi | "parijñāte" samyakniścite | "harṣaviṣāditā na bādhate" iti "tathā"śabdenānukṛṣyate || ṃoṭ_2,18.39 ||


citrasarpaḥ parijñāto na sarpabhayado yathā |
dṛśyasarpaḥ parijñātastathā na sukhaduḥkhadaḥ || ṃo_2,18.40 ||
"parijñātaḥ citrasarpo"'yamiti samyaṅniścitaḥ | dṛśyākhyaḥ sarpaḥ "dṛśyasarpaḥ" || ṃoṭ_2,18.40 ||


parijñānena sarpatvaṃ citrasarpasya naśyati |
yathā tathaiva saṃsāraḥ sthita evopaśāmyati || ṃo_2,18.41 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,18.41 ||


nanu paramārthaprāptirasmākamatiduṣkaraiva | tathā ca tatprāptyarthametacchāstrāvagāhanamayuktamevety | atrāha
sumanaḥpallavāmarśe kiṃcidvyatikaro bhavet |
paramārthapadaprāptau na tu vyatikaro'sti naḥ || ṃo_2,18.42 ||
"sumanaḥpallavāmarśe" puṣpapallavāmarde | "vyatikaraḥ" yatnaḥ | "naḥ" yuktijñānāmasmākam | na tvayuktijñānāṃ bhavatāmityarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.42 ||



vyatikarābhāvameva kathayati
gacchatyavayavaspandaḥ sumanaḥpatramardane |
iha dhīmātrabodhastu nāṅgāvayavabodhanam || ṃo_2,18.43 ||
"gacchati" upayukto bhavati | anekārthatvāddhātūnāṃ "gacchatir" atrāsminnarthe vartate | "aṅgāvayavānāṃ" śarīrāvayavānām | "bodhanam" cālanam || ṃoṭ_2,18.43 ||


sukhāsanopaviṣṭena yathāsambhavamaśnatā |
bhogajālaṃ sadācāraviruddheṣu na tiṣṭhatā || ṃo_2,18.44 ||
yathākṣaṇaṃ yathādeśaṃ pravicārayatā sukham |
yathāsambhavasatsaṅgamidaṃ śāstramathetarat || ṃo_2,18.45 ||
āsādyate mahājñānabodhaḥ saṃsāraśāntidaḥ |
sa bhūyo yena nāyāti yoniyantraprapīḍanam || ṃo_2,18.46 ||
"yathāsambhavam" na tu prayatnasādhitam | "sadācāraviruddheṣu" tiṣṭhato hi hānopādānakāritvarūpo doṣaḥ āyātīti "na tiṣṭhate"tyuktam | "yathākṣaṇam" pratikṣaṇam | "sukham" sukhadāyi | "yathāsambhavaḥ satsaṅgo" yatra tat | "idaṃ śāstraṃ" mayā vakṣyamāṇamokṣopāyākhyaṃ śāstram | "itarat" etatsadṛśamanyacchāstraṃ vā | mahājñānarūpaḥ bodhaḥ "mahājñānabodhaḥ" | "sa" ityasya pūrvārdhena sambandhaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.4446 ||



etāvatyeva ye bhūtā bhogān prāpya rase sthitāḥ |
svamātṛviṣṭhākrimayaḥ kīrtanīyā na te'dhamāḥ || ṃo_2,18.47 ||
"etāvati rase" parimite rase | "bhūtāḥ" sāmānyajantavaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.47 ||


evaṃ śāstramāhātmyamuktvā śrīrāmaṃ saṃmukhīkaroti
śṛṇu tāvadidānīṃ tvaṃ kathyamānamidaṃ mayā |
rāghava jñānavistāraṃ buddhisāratarāntaram || ṃo_2,18.48 ||
"buddheḥ sārataramantaram" yasya tat | buddhyatiśāyītyarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.48 ||



madhye śrīrāmakṛtāṃścodyānāśaṅkyāha
yayedaṃ śrūyate śāstraṃ tāṃ tu vistarataḥ śṛṇu |
vicāryate tathārtho'yaṃ yayā ca paribhāṣayā || ṃo_2,18.49 ||
"yayā paribhāṣayā" yuktyā | "idaṃ śāstraṃ śrūyate" | tvaṃ "tāṃ vistarataḥ śṛṇu" | "tathā" "yayā ca vicāryate" | tāṃ ca śṛṇviti pūrveṇa sambandhaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.49 ||


paribhāṣāmeva kathayati
yenehānanubhūte'rthe dṛṣṭenārthāvabodhanam  |
bodhopakāraphaladaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || ṃo_2,18.50 ||
"yena dṛṣṭenā"rthena | "ananubhūte arthe arthāvabodhanam" jñānaṃ bhavati | "budhāḥ taṃ dṛṣṭāntamāhuḥ" | kathaṃbhūtam | "bodhā"khyaḥ ya "upakāraḥ" | tadeva "phalaṃ" | tad"dadhātī"ti tādṛśam || ṃoṭ_2,18.50 ||



dṛṣṭāntadāne kiṃ phalamity | atrāha
dṛṣṭāntena vinā rāma nāpūrvo'rtho'vabudhyate |
yathā dīpaṃ vinā rātrau bhāṇḍopakaraṇaṃ gṛhe || ṃo_2,18.51 ||
"bhāṇḍopakaraṇaṃ" bhāṇḍasāmagrī || ṃoṭ_2,18.51 ||


yairyaiḥ kākutstha dṛṣṭāntaistvaṃ mayehāvabudhyase |
sarve sakāraṇāste hi prāpyaṃ tu sadakāraṇam || ṃo_2,18.52 ||
"prāpyam" prāpaṇīyam | "sat" sanmātrākhyaṃ vastu || ṃoṭ_2,18.52 ||



nanu sarvāṇi dārṣṭāntikāni etādṛśāni eva santyutānyānyathetyapekṣāyāmāha
upamānopameyānāṃ kāryakāraṇatoditā |
varjayitvā paraṃ brahma sarveṣāmeva vidyate || ṃo_2,18.53 ||
dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikānām "paraṃ brahma varjayitvā" | "uditā" udayanaśīlā | "kāryakāraṇatā vidyate" | brahma na kāryamasti nāpi kāraṇamityarthaḥ | ato na brahmasadṛśāni sarvāṇi dārṣṭāntikāni iti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.53 ||



phalitaṃ kathayati
brahmopadeśadṛṣṭānto yasya veha hi kathyate |
ekadeśasadharmatvaṃ tatrātaḥ parigṛhyate || ṃo_2,18.54 ||
"hi" niścaye | "ataḥ" kāraṇāt | "iha" loke | "yasya vā brahmopadeśadṛṣṭāntaḥ kathyate tatra" brahmadṛṣṭānte | "ekadeśasadharmatvaṃ" ekadeśasadṛśatvam | "parigṛhyate" | na tu sarvathā sadṛśatvaṃ dārṣṭāntikasya brahmaṇaḥ kāryakāraṇatvāyogyāt | dṛṣṭāntasya tu kāryatayā kāraṇatayā ca sthitatvāditi bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.54 ||



yo yo nāmeha dṛṣṭānto brahmatattvāvabodhane |
dīyate sa sa boddhavyaḥ svapnadṛṣṭajagadgataḥ || ṃo_2,18.55 ||
"svapnadṛṣṭajagadgataḥ" bhramarūpaḥ ityarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.55 ||



phalitamāha
evaṃ sati nirākāre brahmaṇyākāravān katham |
dṛṣṭānta iti nodyanti mūrkhavaikalpikoktayaḥ || ṃo_2,18.56 ||
"nodyanti" nottiṣṭhanti | asmābhirata eva pratyuktatvāditi bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.56 ||



anyā siddhaviruddhādidṛkdṛṣṭāntapradūṣaṇe |
svapnopamatvājjagataḥ samudeti na kācana || ṃo_2,18.57 ||
"anyā" pūrvoktāyāḥ dṛṣṭeḥ sakāśātitarā kā | "na kā"pi | "siddhaviruddhādidṛk" idaṃ siddhamidaṃ viruddhamityādirūpā uktiḥ | "jagataḥ svapnopamatvātdṛṣṭāntapradūṣaṇe" dṛṣṭāntapradūṣaṇārtham "na samudeti" | "ādi"śabdenedaṃ leśena siddhaṃ viruddhaṃ veti dṛṣṭergrahaṇam | svapnopame jagati idaṃ siddhamidaṃ viruddhamiti | kathanaṃ na yuktaṃ sarvasyāyuktatvāditi bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.57 ||



avastu pūrvāparayorvartamānavicāritam |
yathā jāgrattathā svapnaḥ siddhamābālamakṣatam || ṃo_2,18.58 ||
"pūrvāparayoḥ" bhūtabhaviṣyatorarthayoḥ | "avastu" bhāvapradhāno nirdeśaḥ | "avastutvam" asattvam "vartamānavicāritaṃ" bhavati | vartamāne hi bhūtasya gatatvātbhaviṣyataḥ anāgatatvātasattvaṃ vicārapadavīmāyāti | tadabhinnasya vartamānasyāpi avastutvam  aparihāryameveti svayameva jñeyam | ataḥ "ābālam" bālaparyantam | "yathā svapnaḥ tathā jāgrad" iti | "akṣataṃ" samyak | "siddham" bhavati || ṃoṭ_2,18.58 ||



svapnasaṃkalpanadhyānavaraśāpauṣadhādibhiḥ |
ye'rthāsta iha dṛṣṭāntāstadrūpatvājjagatsthiteḥ || ṃo_2,18.59 ||
"ye'rthā" ity | atra "dṛṣṭā" iti śeṣaḥ | "tadrūpatvāt" svapnādyartharūpatvāt | ata "ihā"satyaiḥ padārthaiḥ satyasya brahmaṇaḥ upamānopameyabhāvaḥ ekadeśasādharmyeṇeti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.59 ||



nanu tvayā kṛteṣvanyeṣu grantheṣu kā vārtety | atrāha
mokṣopāyakṛtā granthakāreṇānye'pi ye kṛtāḥ |
granthāsteṣviyamevaikā vyavasthā bodhyabodhane  || ṃo_2,18.60 ||
"mokṣopāyakṛtā granthakāreṇa" mayetyarthaḥ | "bodhyasya" bodhanīyasya brahmatattvasya | "bodhane" kathane | "vyavasthā" rītiḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.60 ||



nanu kathaṃ svapnasadṛśatvaṃ jagato'stīty | atrāha
svapnābhatvaṃ ca jagataḥ śrute śāstre'vabhotsyate  |
śīghraṃ na pāryate vaktuṃ vākkila kramavartinī || ṃo_2,18.61 ||
"avabhotsyate" jñātuṃ śakyate | tarhi yugapadeva sarvaṃ śāstraṃ kathayety | atrāha | "śīghram" iti | "vācaḥ kramavartitvaṃ" sphuṭameva | "na" hi ekaṃ vākyamanirvāhya dvitīyādikaṃ vākyaṃ "vaktuṃ" śakyate || ṃoṭ_2,18.61 ||



svapnasaṃkalpasudhyānanagarādyupamaṃ jagat |
yatasta eva dṛṣṭāntāstasmādbhāntīha netare || ṃo_2,18.62 ||
"yataḥ jagat" | "svapnasaṃkalpasudhyāneṣu" dṛṣṭāḥ ye "nagarādayaḥ" | teṣāṃ "upamā" yasya | tādṛśaṃ bhavati | "tasmātta eva sudhyānanagarādaya" eva "dṛṣṭāntāḥ bhānti" asmākaṃ buddhau sphuranti | "itare" satyabhūtāḥ nagarādayaḥ | "na" bhānti ayuktatvāt || ṃoṭ_2,18.62 ||



akāraṇaṃ kāraṇinā yadbodhāyopamīyate |
na tatra sarvasādharmyaṃ sambhavatyupamābhramaiḥ || ṃo_2,18.63 ||
"akāraṇaṃ" kāraṇarahitaṃ brahma | "kāraṇinā" kāraṇayuktenākāśādinā | "upamābhramaiḥ" anyopamādṛṣṭasarvathāsādharmyarūpaiḥ viparyayaiḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.63 ||


upameyasyopamānādekāṃśena sadharmatā |
aṅgīkāryāvabodhāya dhīmatā nirvivādinā || ṃo_2,18.64 ||
"dhīmatā" na tvadhīmatā | sa hi ārambha eva vivādapara eva tiṣṭhatīti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.64 ||


nanvekena dharmeṇa sadṛśena upamānaṃ kathamupameyasya pratītiṃ kartuṃ śaknotīty | atra dṛṣṭāntaṃ sādhayati
arthāvalokane dīpādābhāmātrādṛte kila |
na sthālatailavartyādi kiṃcidapyupajāyate || ṃo_2,18.65 ||
"ābhāmātrāt" prakāśamātrarūpāt | "sthālam" pātram || ṃoṭ_2,18.65 ||



etadeva dārṣṭāntikayuktaṃ kathayati
ekadeśasadharmatvādupameyāvabodhanam |
upamānaṃ karotyaṅga dīpo'rthaṃ prabhayā yathā || ṃo_2,18.66 ||
"prabhayā" prabhākhyenaikadeśena || ṃoṭ_2,18.66 ||


dṛṣṭāntasyāṃśamātreṇa bodhyabodhodaye sati |
upādeyatayā grāhyo mahāvākyārthaniścayaḥ || ṃo_2,18.67 ||
na tu dṛṣṭāntamātra eva sthātavyamiti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.67 ||


na kutārkikatāmetya nāśanīyā prabuddhatā |
anubhūtyapalāpāttairapavitrairvikalpitaiḥ || ṃo_2,18.68 ||
"prabuddhatā" jñānitā | "kutārkikāḥ" hi ārambha eva codyān dattvā prabuddhatāṃ nāśayanti | "vikalpitaiḥ" kathaṃbhūtaiḥ | "anubhūte" yaḥ "apalāpaḥ" nihnavaḥ | tena "āttaiḥ" gṛhītaiḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.68 ||



nanu purāṇāni śāstrāṇi ca tyaktvā kimarthaṃ tvaduktaṃ śāstraṃ gṛhṇīmaḥ ity | atrāha
vicāraṇādanubhavakāri vāṅmaya
prasaṅgatāmupagatamasmadādiṣu |
striyoktamapyaparamathāpi vaidikaṃ
vaco vacaḥpralapanameva nāgamaḥ || ṃo_2,18.69 ||
"asmadādiṣu" prāmāṇikeṣu | "striyā uktamapi" strīkartṛkaṃ pralapitamapi | "vāṅmayaprasaṅgatām" śāstraprasaṅgatām | śāstratvamiti yāvat | "upagatam" | kathaṃbhūtaṃ tat | "vicāraṇātanubhavakāri" | "atha" pakṣāntare | "vaidikaṃ vacaḥ api vacaḥpralapanameva" pralāpa eva bhavati | "nāgamaḥ" bhavati anubhavakāritvābhāvādityarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,18.69 ||


sargāntaślokenāpyetadeva kathayati
asmākamasti matiraṅga tayeti sarva
śāstraikavākyakaraṇaṃ phalitaṃ yato'taḥ |
prātītikārthamayaśāstranijāṅgapuṣṭāt
saṃvedanāditaradasti na naḥ pramāṇam || ṃo_2,18.70 ||
he "aṅga" | "asmākaṃ matirasti iti" | "ataḥ" hetoḥ | "asmākaṃ tayā" buddhyā | "sarvaśāstraikavākyakaraṇaṃ yataḥ phalitam" | "ataḥ" hetoḥ | "naḥ" asmākam | "saṃvedanāt" jñānāt | anyat"pramāṇaṃ nāsti" | sarvasmiñśāstre saṃvedanamevāsmābhiḥ pramāṇaṃ dṛṣṭam | ato'smākamapi tadeva pramāṇamiti bhāvaḥ | "saṃvedanāt" kathaṃbhūtāt | "prātītikaḥ" pratīterāgataḥ | na tu kalpitaḥ | yaḥ "arthaḥ" | tan"mayam" yat"śāstraṃ" | tadeva "nijāṅgam" upakārakatvātsvāṅgam | tena "puṣṭāt" vṛddhiṃ gatāt || ṃoṭ_2,18.70 ||




iti śrībhāskarakaṇṭhaviracitāyāṃ śrīmokṣopāyaṭīkāyāṃ mumukṣuprakaraṇe aṣṭādaśaḥ sargaḥ || 2,18 ||


************************************************************************

oṃ pūrvoktamevārthaṃ punarapi spaṣṭayati
viśiṣṭāṃśasadharmatvamupamāneṣu gṛhyate |
ko bhedaḥ sarvasādṛśye tūpamānopameyayoḥ || ṃo_2,19.1 ||
"viśiṣṭāṃśena" kāryasādhakenāṃśena | "sādharmyaṃ" sādṛśyam | ekāṃśenāpi kāryasya siddhatvānna ko'pītyarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,19.1 ||


dṛṣṭāntabuddhādekātmajñānaśāstrārthavedanāt |
mahāvākyārthasaṃvittyā śāntirnirvāṇamucyate || ṃo_2,19.2 ||
"ekam" kevalam | "ātmajñānaṃ" pratipādyatvena yasmin | tādṛśaṃ yat"śāstraṃ" | tasya yo "'rthaḥ" | tasya "vedanāt" vicārāt | utpannayā "mahāvākyārthasaṃvittyā" | garbhīkṛtāvāntaravākyamahāvākyārthaparicchedena | siddhā "śāntiḥ" manaḥkṣobharāhityam | paṇḍitaiḥ "nirvāṇamucyate" | "vedanāt" kathaṃbhūtāt | "dṛṣṭāntaiḥ buddhāt" jñātātsiddhāditi yāvat || ṃoṭ_2,19.2 ||



upasaṃhāraṃ karoti
tasmāddṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntavikalpollasitairalam |
yayā kayācidyuktyāśu mahāvākyārthamāśrayet || ṃo_2,19.3 ||
"alam" kṛtam | naitaiḥ prayojanamityarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,19.3 ||


śāntiḥ śreyaḥ paraṃ viddhi tatprāptau yatnavān bhavet |
bhoktavya odanaḥ prāptaḥ kiṃ tatsiddhivikalpitaiḥ || ṃo_2,19.4 ||
"śāntiḥ" manovikalparūpakṣobharāhityam | "siddhivikalpitaiḥ" kathametatsampannamiti vikalpaiḥ || ṃoṭ_2,19.4 ||


akāraṇaṃ kāraṇibhirbodhārthamupamīyate |
upamānaistūpameyasadṛśairekadeśataḥ || ṃo_2,19.5 ||
"akāraṇaṃ" kāraṇarahitabrahma | "ekadeśataḥ" ekena dharmeṇa || ṃoṭ_2,19.5 ||


sthātavyaṃ neha bhogeṣu vivekavikalātmanā |
upalodarasaṃjātaparipīnāndhabhekavat || ṃo_2,19.6 ||
spaṣṭam || ṃoṭ_2,19.6 ||


dṛṣṭāntairyuktibhiryatnādvāñchitaṃ tyajatetarat |
vicāraṇavatā bhāvyaṃ śāntiśāstrārthaśālinā || ṃo_2,19.7 ||
"vāñchitaṃ" abhilaṣitam | "itarat" vicāravyatiriktam | "śāntiś" ca "śāstrārthaś" ca tābhyāṃ śālate iti tādṛśena || ṃoṭ_2,19.7 ||


śāstropaśamasaujanyaprajñātajjñasamāgamaiḥ  |
antarāntarasampannadharmyārthopārjanakriyaḥ || ṃo_2,19.8 ||
tāvadvicārayetprājño yāvadviśrāntimātmani |
samprayātyapunarnāśāṃ śāntiṃ turyapadābhidhām || ṃo_2,19.9 ||
"śāstraṃ" ca "upaśamaś" ca "saujanyaṃ" ca "prajñā" ca "tajjñasamāgamaś" ca | taiḥ upalakṣitaḥ | "antarāntare" madhye madhye "sampannāḥ" | "dharmyānāṃ" dharmādanapetānāṃ "arthānāmupārjanam" | tasya "kriyāḥ" yasya saḥ | tādṛśaḥ "prājñaḥ tāvatvicārayet" | "yāvatapunarnāśāṃ" pradhvaṃsābhāvarahitām | "turyapadābhidhāṃ" turyapadeti nāmadheyām | "ātmani viśrāntiṃ" ātmaviśrāntilakṣaṇāṃ śāntim | "samprayāti" || ṃoṭ_2,19.89 ||



nanvātmani viśrāntyā kiṃ setsyatīty | atrāha
turyaviśrāntiyuktasya pratīrṇasya bhavārṇavāt |
jīvato'jīvataścaiva gṛhasthasyātha vā yateḥ || ṃo_2,19.10 ||
na kṛtenākṛtenārtho na śrutismṛtivibhramaiḥ |
nirmandara ivāṃbhodhiḥ sa tiṣṭhati yathāsthitam || ṃo_2,19.11 ||
"jīvataḥ" jīvanmuktasy"ājīvataḥ" videhamuktasya | "arthaḥ" prayojanam | nanu kathamasau tiṣṭhatīty | atrāha | "nirmandara" iti | "saḥ" viśrāntiyuktaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,19.1011 ||


ekāṃśenopamānānāmupameyasadharmatā |
boddhavyā bodhyabodhāya na stheyaṃ codyacañcunā || ṃo_2,19.12 ||
"codyena cañcuḥ" vittaḥ | prasiddha iti yāvat | iti "codyacañcuḥ" codyaśīlenetyarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,19.12 ||



yayā kayācidyuktyāśu boddhavyaṃ bodhyameva te |
muktaye tanna paśyanti vyākulāścodyacañcavaḥ || ṃo_2,19.13 ||
"te" iti kartari ṣaṣṭhī | "tvām" iti śeṣaḥ | "vyākulāḥ codyacañcavaḥ" | "tat" tadā | tvām "na paśyanti" | kimutādhigacchantīti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,19.13 ||



codyacañcoḥ lakṣaṇaṃ kathayati
hṛdaye saṃvidākāśe viśrānte'nubhavātmani |
vastunyanarthaṃ yaḥ praṣṭā codyacañcuḥ sa ucyate || ṃo_2,19.14 ||
"hṛdaye" manasi | "viśrānte"'pi "anubhavātmani saṃvidākāśe" cidākāśe | "vastuni yaḥ anartham" saṃśayarūpamanartham | "praṣṭā" pṛcchakaḥ bhavati | paṇḍitaiḥ "saḥ codyacañcuḥ ucyate" | svānubhavāviṣṭe'pi vastuni yaḥ punaḥ punaḥ codyānutpādayati saḥ codyacañcuriti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,19.14 ||



abhimānavikalpāṃśairajño jñaptiṃ vikalpayan |
bodhaṃ malinayatyantarmukhaṃ sarpa ivāmalam || ṃo_2,19.15 ||
"abhimānenā"haṃ samyakcodanaśīla ityabhimānena kṛtaiḥ "vikalpāṃśaiḥ" | codyarūpaiḥ vikalpāṃśaiḥ | "antaḥ" svasmin | "ajñaḥ" svām "jñaptiṃ" buddhim | "vikalpayan" vikalpayuktāṃ kurvan | "bodhaṃ malinayati" bhedamālinyadūṣitaṃ karoti | ataḥ tvayā vyarhāḥ vikalpāḥ | na kāryā iti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,19.15 ||


upadeśe upayogyānāṃ pramāṇāṃ nirṇayaṃ prastauti
sarvapramāṇasattānāṃ padamabdhirapāmiva |
pramāṇamekameveha pratyakṣaṃ rāma tacchṛṇu || ṃo_2,19.16 ||
"sarvāsām" anumānādibhedabhinnānāṃ samastānāṃ "pramāṇasattānāṃ" | "abdhirivāpāṃ" sthānamāśrayam | "ekaṃ pratyakṣameva iha" loke "pramāṇam" asti | na hi anumānādayaḥ pratyakṣaṃ vinā sthātuṃ śaknuvanti | he "rāma" | tvam "tat" pratyakṣaṃ nāma pramāṇam | "śṛṇu" || ṃoṭ_2,19.16 ||



pratyakṣameva kathayati
sarvārthasāramadhyakṣaṃ vedanaṃ viduruttamāḥ |
nūnaṃ tatprati yatsiddhaṃ tatpratyakṣamudāhṛtam || ṃo_2,19.17 ||
"uttamāḥ" śreṣṭhāḥ | "sarvārthānāṃ sāra"prakāśanadvāreṇa siddhipradatvātsārabhūtaṃ "vedanaṃ" jñānameva | "adhyakṣaṃ viduḥ" sārabhūtavastuvācakatvād"adhyakṣa"śabdasya | he rāma | "nūnaṃ" niścaye | "tatprati" vedanarūpamadhyakṣaṃ prati | "yatsiddhaṃ" bhavati | paṇḍitaiḥ "tad" vastu "pratyakṣamudāhṛtam" | akṣaṃ prati siddhaṃ pratyakṣamiti vyutpatteḥ | akṣaśabdasya ca bhāmetivadadhyakṣavācakatvam || ṃoṭ_2,19.17 ||


tataḥ kimity | atrāha
anubhūtervedanasya pratipatteryathāsthitam |
pratyakṣamiti nāmeha kṛtaṃ jīvaḥ sa eva ca || ṃo_2,19.18 ||
ataḥ paṇḍitaiḥ | "anubhūteḥ" anubhūtirūpasya | "pratipatteḥ" pratipattirūpasya | "vedanasya" | "iha" loke | "yathāsthitam" na tvanyathā saṃbhāvitam | "pratyakṣamiti nāma kṛtam" | vedanasyaiva vedanaṃ prati siddhatvādanyasya sarvasya tasmiṃllayāsādanāt"sa eva jīvaḥ" bhavati | vedanādanyasya śarīrādeḥ pāṣāṇatulyatvena jīvatvāyogātanubhūtipratipattyoḥ sphuṭatvāsphuṭatvakṛto bhedo jñeyaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,19.18 ||


padārthānāmetadrūpatvameva kathayati
sa eva saṃvitsa punarahaṃtāpratyayātmakaḥ |
sa yayodeti saṃvittyā sā padārtha iti smṛtā || ṃo_2,19.19 ||
"sa eva" jīva eva | ārohāvasthāyāṃ "saṃvit" bhavati | "sa" evāvarohāvasthāyāṃ "ahaṃtāpratyayātmakaḥ" bhavati | "saḥ" ahaṃtāpratyayātmakaḥ jīvaḥ | "yayā saṃvittyā" yena ghaṭādisaṃvedanena rūpeṇa | "udeti" sphurati | "sā" saṃvittiḥ | paṇḍitaiḥ "padārtha iti smṛtā" | na hi padārthasya saṃvittivyatirekeṇa pṛthaksvarūpamasti | sattve'pyasan kalpatvāt | na hi saṃvittiṃ vinā satsatbhavati || ṃoṭ_2,19.19 ||



padārthānāṃ jagattvaṃ kathayati
sa saṃkalpavikalpādyaiḥ kṛtanānākramo bhramaiḥ |
jagattayā sphuratyambu taraṅgāditayā yathā || ṃo_2,19.20 ||
"saḥ" padārthaḥ | "saṃkalpavikalpādyaiḥ" saṃkalpavikalpaprabhṛtibhiḥ pramātṛniṣṭaiḥ viparyayajñānaiḥ | "kṛtanānākramaḥ" san | "jagattayā sphurati" | kiṃ "yathā" | "ambu yathā" | "yathā" tat"taraṅgāditayā" sphurati tathetyarthaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,19.20 ||


nanu śuddhasya vedanasya kathamevaṃrūpatā sampannety | atrāha
prāgakāraṇamevāśu sargādau sargalīlayā |
sphuritvā kāraṇībhūtaṃ pratyakṣaṃ svayamātmani || ṃo_2,19.21 ||
"pratyakṣaṃ" vedanarūpaṃ pratyakṣam | "prāk" sargātprāk | "akāraṇameva" sat | "sargādau" sargonmukhatāsamaye | "sargalīlayā sphuritvā" | "ātmani" sargarūpe svātmani | "svayaṃ" svātantryeṇa | "kāraṇībhūtam" | na ca svātantryakṛte kathamiti paryanuyogaḥ yuktaḥ iti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,19.21 ||



nanu vedanarūpasya jīvasya kāraṇatvaṃ kiṃrūpamastīty | atrāha
kāraṇatvaṃ vicāro'sya jīvasyāsadapi sthitam |
sadivāsyāṃ jagadrūpasampattau vyaktimāgatam || ṃo_2,19.22 ||
"jagadrūpasampattau vicāraḥ" vimarśaḥ | "asya" śuddhavedanarūpasya "jīvasya" | vā "kāraṇatvaṃ" bhavati | kathambhūtaṃ "kāranatvaṃ" | "asadapi" paramārthataḥ asatsvarūpamapi | "sadiva sthitam" | punaḥ kathambhūtam | abhi"vyaktiṃ" prākaṭyaṃ "gatam" || ṃoṭ_2,19.22 ||


nanu punarapi kiṃ tasya jīvasya kāraṇatvaṃ naśyatyatha vā nety | atrāha
svayameva vicārastu sanañarthaṃ svakaṃ vapuḥ |
nāśayitvā karotyāśu pratyakṣaṃ paramaṃ padam || ṃo_2,19.23 ||
"svayameva vicāraḥ sanañarthaṃ" svābhāvayuktam | "svakaṃ vapuḥ" nijavicārākhyaṃ svarūpaṃ "nāśayitvā" | "paramaṃ padaṃ" kāraṇatvānavacchinnaṃ svasvarūpam | "pratyakṣaṃ" "karoti" | vicāravaśādeva | punarapi jīvasya kāraṇatvaṃ naśyatīti bhāvaḥ || ṃoṭ_2,19.23 ||


nanu vicāraḥ kathaṃ paramaṃ padaṃ pratyakṣīkarotītyapekṣāyāmāha
vicārayan vicāro'pi nātmānamadhigacchati |
yadā tadā nirullekhaṃ paramevāvaśiṣyate  || ṃo_2,19.24 ||
